test("route utilities stay styled across auth and portal navigation", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" })
  await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN")
  await page.goto("/login")
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard$/)
  const dashboard = page.getByRole("main", { name: "Dashboard", exact: true })
  await expect(dashboard).toHaveCSS("border-radius", "13px")
  await expect(dashboard).toHaveCSS("background-color", "rgb(243, 247, 249)")

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign Out", exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/)
  await expect(page.locator("main[lang]")).toHaveCSS("display", "grid")
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 })
  await expect(page.locator("main[lang]")).toHaveCSS("display", "block")
  await expect(page.locator("aside")).toBeHidden()
})

test(`client package card sizing with ${packageCount} packages at ${width}px`, async ({
        page,
      }, testInfo) => {
        await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 1000 })
        const timestamp = "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
        await restoreSession(page, "USER", {
          initialServices: [
            {
              id: "layout-service",
              name: "Layout Service",
              description: "Support for your next project.",
              iconKey: "sparkles",
              imageUrl: null,
              imageAltText: null,
              clientRequirements: [],
              requiresConsultation: false,
              consultationNotes: null,
              keyBenefits: [],
              isActive: true,
              pricingTemplateId: null,
              pricingTemplate: null,
              departments: [],
              createdAt: timestamp,
              updatedAt: timestamp,
              packages: Array.from({ length: packageCount }, (_, index) => ({
                id: `package-${index}`,
                name: `Package ${index + 1}`,
                description: "Project support.",
                includedFeatures: ["Dedicated specialist"],
                pricingModel: "CUSTOM_QUOTE",
                currency: "PHP",
                amount: null,
                billingInterval: null,
                isPricingPublic: false,
                isActive: true,
                isRecommended: index === 0,
                displayOrder: index,
                createdAt: timestamp,
                updatedAt: timestamp,
              })),
            },
          ],
        })
        await page.goto("/services")
        await page
          .getByRole("button", { name: "Explore Layout Service" })
          .click()
        await page
          .getByRole("dialog")
          .getByRole("button", { name: "EXPlore", exact: true })
          .click()
        const cards = page
          .getByRole("group", { name: "Packages & pricing" })
          .getByRole("article")
        await expect(cards).toHaveCount(Math.max(1, packageCount))
        const bounds = await cards.evaluateAll((elements) =>
          elements.map((element) => {
            const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect()
            return {
              width: rect.width,
              height: rect.height,
              overflow: element.scrollWidth > element.clientWidth,
            }
          }),
        )
        for (const card of bounds) {
          expect(card.width).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(280)
          expect(card.width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(331)
          expect(card.height).toBeLessThan(500)
          expect(card.overflow).toBe(false)
        }
        await cards.first().scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
        await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath("card-layout.png") })
      })

tests.source:
test("client catalog retries failures and resets pagination when filtering", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    const timestamp = "2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z"
    const services: Service[] = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, index) => ({
      id: `catalog-${index}`,
      name: `Catalog Service ${index + 1}`,
      description: "Business support",
      iconKey: "sparkles",
      imageUrl: null,
      imageAltText: null,
      clientRequirements: [],
      requiresConsultation: false,
      consultationNotes: null,
      keyBenefits: [],
      isActive: true,
      pricingTemplateId: null,
      pricingTemplate: null,
      packages: [],
      departments: [
        {
          id: index < 8 ? "engineering" : "marketing",
          name: index < 8 ? "Engineering" : "Marketing",
          code: null,
          color: "teal",
        },
      ],
      createdAt: timestamp,
      updatedAt: timestamp,
    }))
    await restoreSession(page, "USER", { initialServices: services })
    await page.route(
      "**/api/client/services",
      (route) =>
        route.fulfill({
          status: 503,
          json: { error: "Catalog temporarily unavailable" },
        }),
      { times: 1 },
    )
    await page.goto("/services")
    await expect(page.getByRole("main").getByRole("alert")).toContainText(
      "Catalog temporarily unavailable",
    )
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Explore Catalog Service/ }),
    ).toHaveCount(8)
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Next page", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Explore Catalog Service/ }),
    ).toHaveCount(2)
    await page
      .getByRole("combobox", { name: "Filter services by department" })
      .click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Engineering", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: "Page 1", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("aria-current", "page")
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Explore Catalog Service/ }),
    ).toHaveCount(8)
    await page
      .getByRole("searchbox", { name: "Search services" })
      .fill("' OR 1=1 --")
    await expect(
      page.getByText("No services found", { exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Explore Catalog Service/ }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await page
      .getByRole("searchbox", { name: "Search services" })
      .fill("Catalog Service 3")
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Explore Catalog Service/ }),
    ).toHaveCount(1)
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", {
        name: "Explore Catalog Service 3",
        exact: true,
      }),
    ).toBeVisible()
  })

test("admin can create, edit, delete departments and open member management", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN")
    await page.goto("/departments")

    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Department Management" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: "Engineering", exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()

    // 1. Create a Department
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Create Department", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Create Department" }),
    ).toBeVisible()

    await page.getByLabel("Department Name").fill("Customer Support")
    await page.getByLabel("Department Code").fill("CS")
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("radiogroup", { name: "Department color" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole("radio", { name: "Green", exact: true }).click()
    const createdDepartment = page.waitForRequest(
      (request) =>
        request.method() === "POST" &&
        new URL(request.url()).pathname === "/api/departments",
    )
    await page
      .getByRole("dialog")
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Create Department" })
      .click()

    await expect(page.getByText("Customer Support")).toBeVisible()
    expect((await createdDepartment).postDataJSON()).toMatchObject({
      name: "Customer Support",
      color: "green",
    })
    await page.reload()

    // 2. Edit the Department
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Customer Support" }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Edit Department" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("radio", { name: "Green", exact: true }),
    ).toBeChecked()
    await page.getByLabel("Department Name").fill("Client Success")
    await page
      .getByRole("dialog")
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Update Department" })
      .click()

    await expect(page.getByText("Client Success")).toBeVisible()

    // 3. Open Member Management Sheet
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Client Success", exact: true })
      .click()

    // Member Management Drawer / Sheet opens
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Members & teams" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Close drawer" }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Members & teams" }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)

    // 4. Delete the Department
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "More actions for Client Success" })
      .click()
    await page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Delete department" }).click()

    await expect(page.getByText("Delete department?")).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Delete department", exact: true })
      .click()

    await expect(page.getByText("Client Success")).toHaveCount(0)
  })

      page,
    }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
      const employees: Employee[] = ["Alex Employee", "Second Employee"].map(
        (fullName, index) => ({
          id: `employee-${index + 1}`,
          employeeId: `EXP-00${index + 1}`,
          fullName,
          email: `employee${index}@example.com`,
          contactNumber: "09123456789",
          position: "Designer",
          employmentType: "FULL_TIME",
          status: "ACTIVE",
          startDate: "2026-01-15",
          departmentId: null,
          teamId: null,
          department: null,
          team: null,
          hasAccount: true,
          accountIsActive: true,
          createdAt: "2026-01-15T00:00:00Z",
          updatedAt: "2026-01-15T00:00:00Z",
        }),
      )
      await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN", { initialEmployees: employees })
      await page.goto("/employees")
      const first = page.getByRole("button", {
        name: "More actions for Alex Employee",
        exact: true,
      })
      const second = page.getByRole("button", {
        name: "More actions for Second Employee",
        exact: true,
      })
      await second.click()
      await expect(page.getByRole("menu")).toHaveCount(1)
      await expect(second).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "true")
      await first.click()
      await expect(page.getByRole("menu")).toHaveCount(1)
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("menu", {
          name: "Actions for Alex Employee",
          exact: true,
        }),
      ).toBeVisible()
      await expect(first).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "true")
      await expect(second).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "false")
      await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
      await expect(page.getByRole("menu")).toHaveCount(0)
      await expect(first).toBeFocused()
    })

import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"
import type {
  PricingTemplate,
  Service,
} from "../src/features/services/api/services-api"
import { Permissions } from "../src/features/auth/model/permissions"
import {
  configureRegressionTest,
  live,
  restoreSession,
} from "./regression-support"

configureRegressionTest()

const timestamp = "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
const sharedTemplate: PricingTemplate = {
  id: "shared-pricing",
  name: "Shared pricing",
  pricingModel: "FIXED",
  currency: "PHP",
  amount: "1000.00",
  billingInterval: null,
  isPublic: true,
  createdAt: timestamp,
  updatedAt: timestamp,
}
const unusedTemplate: PricingTemplate = {
  ...sharedTemplate,
  id: "unused-pricing",
  name: "Unused pricing",
}
const service: Service = {
  id: "service-1",
  name: "Test Service",
  description: "A service using reusable pricing.",
  iconKey: "sparkles",
  imageUrl: null,
  imageAltText: null,
  clientRequirements: [],
  requiresConsultation: false,
  consultationNotes: null,
  keyBenefits: [],
  isActive: true,
  pricingTemplateId: sharedTemplate.id,
  pricingTemplate: sharedTemplate,
  packages: [],
  departments: [
    { id: "dept-1", name: "Engineering", code: "ENG", color: "teal" },
  ],
  createdAt: timestamp,
  updatedAt: timestamp,
}

test.describe("Pricing template management", () => {
  test.skip(live, "Uses an offline mocked catalog")

  for (const width of [1440, 390]) {
    test(`customizes shared templates and confirms deletion of unused templates at ${width}px`, async ({
      page,
    }, testInfo) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
      await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN", {
        initialServices: [{ ...service }],
        pricingTemplates: [{ ...sharedTemplate }, { ...unusedTemplate }],
      })
      await page.goto("/services")
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Pricing Templates", exact: true })
        .click()
      const manager = page.getByRole("dialog", {
        name: "Pricing Templates",

      .getByRole("button", { name: "Mark complete", exact: true })
      .click()

      page.getByText("Couldn't update milestone", { exact: true }),

    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: "Mark complete", exact: true }),
    ).toBeEnabled()
    state.failUpdate = false
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Mark complete", exact: true })
      .click()

tests.source:
test("an expired service update retries the same payload once after refresh", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    let token = "test-session"
    let refreshes = 0
    const updates: ServiceInput[] = []
    await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN", { accessToken: () => token })
    await page.route("**/api/services/service-1", async (route) => {
      expect(route.request().method()).toBe("PUT")
      updates.push(route.request().postDataJSON() as ServiceInput)
      if (updates.length === 1)
        await route.fulfill({ status: 401, json: expiredAccess })
      else {
        expect(route.request().headers().authorization).toBe(
          `Bearer ${renewedTokens.token}`,
        )
        await route.fallback()
      }
    })
    await page.route("**/api/auth/refresh", async (route) => {
      refreshes++
      token = renewedTokens.token
      await route.fulfill({ json: renewedTokens })
    })
    await page.goto("/services")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page
      .getByRole("dialog")
      .getByLabel("Service Name")
      .fill("Renewed Service")
    await page
      .getByRole("dialog")
      .getByRole("navigation", { name: "Service form progress" })
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Pricing" })
      .click()
    await page
      .getByRole("dialog")
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(page.getByRole("dialog")).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("rowheader", { name: "Renewed Service", exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    expect(refreshes).toBe(1)
    expect(updates).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(updates[1]).toEqual(updates[0])
    expect(updates[1].name).toBe("Renewed Service")
  })

test(`client requests a reschedule for a general conversation meeting at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 920 })
    const state = sharedFixture()
    const startsAt = new Date(Date.now() + 86_400_000).toISOString()
    const meeting: ConversationMeeting = {
      id: "general-meeting",
      conversationId: "shared-design",
      startsAt,
      endsAt: new Date(Date.now() + 88_200_000).toISOString(),
      location: "Office",
      notes: "General catch-up",
      status: "SCHEDULED",
      version: 0,
      proposedStartsAt: null,
      rescheduleNote: null,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      bookings: [],
    }
    state.meetings.set("shared-design", [meeting])
    await mock(page, state, "USER")
    await page.route(
      "**/api/request-conversations/shared-design/meetings/general-meeting",
      async (route) => {
        const action = route.request().postDataJSON() as {
          type: string
          startsAt: string
          note: string
          expectedVersion: number
        }
        expect(action.type).toBe("REQUEST_RESCHEDULE")
        expect(action.expectedVersion).toBe(0)
        meeting.proposedStartsAt = action.startsAt
        meeting.rescheduleNote = action.note
        meeting.version++
        return route.fulfill({ json: { meeting } })
      },
    )
    await page.goto("/messages?request=shared-design")
    const log = page.getByRole("log", { name: "Conversation messages" })
    await log
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Request reschedule", exact: true })
      .click()
    const later = new Date(Date.now() + 2 * 86_400_000)
    await log
      .getByLabel("Requested date and time", { exact: true })
      .fill(
        new Date(later.getTime() - later.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000)
          .toISOString()
          .slice(0, 16),
      )
    await log
      .getByLabel("Reason for rescheduling", { exact: true })
      .fill("Please move our general catch-up")
    await log
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Send reschedule request", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(log).toContainText(
      "The existing schedule remains until the department head confirms a change.",
    )
    await expect(
      log.getByRole("button", { name: "Request reschedule", exact: true }),
    ).toBeDisabled()
    await expect(
      log.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel meeting", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    expect(meeting.startsAt).toBe(startsAt)
  })

    state.conversations![0]!.bookings![2]!.status = "CANCELLED"

      id: "agreement-booking",
      referenceNumber: "SR-104",
      workflowState: "AGREEMENT_PAYMENT_PENDING",
    })
    await mock(page, state, "STAFF")
    let failWorkflow = true
    await page.route("**/api/request-workflows/website", (route) =>
      failWorkflow
        ? route.fulfill({
            status: 503,
            json: { error: "Booking tools temporarily unavailable" },
          })
        : route.fallback(),
    )
    await page.goto("/messages?request=shared-design")
    const chat = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Request conversation" })
    const tools = chat.getByRole("button", {
      name: "Open request actions",
      exact: true,
    })
    await tools.click()
    const menu = page.getByRole("menu")
    await expect(menu.getByRole("radio")).toHaveCount(0)
    for (const name of [
      "Attach file",
      "Request information",
      "Schedule consultation/meeting",
      "Create quotation",
    ])
      await expect(
        menu.getByRole("menuitem", { name, exact: true }),
      ).toBeEnabled()
    await expect(menu.getByRole("menuitem")).toHaveCount(4)
    for (const name of [
      "Payment and commencement",

      "Internal notes",
      "Staffing and workload",

    page,

      fullPage: true,

test(`status filtering, sorting and exact-request chat feedback at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
    const state = await mockInbox(page)
    state.requests.forEach((request, index) => {
      request.service.name = index % 2 ? "Zebra service" : "Alpha service"
    })
    state.requests.push({ ...fixture(12), status: "CANCELLED" })
    await page.goto("/request-inbox")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", {
        name: "Go to chat for request booking-1",
        exact: true,
      })
      .click()
    await expect(
      page.getByText(
        "Accept this request for your department before opening its conversation.",
        { exact: true },
      ),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/request-inbox$/)
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Sort requests", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Sort by reference", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", {
        name: "Sort by reference, ascending",
        exact: true,
      })
      .click()
    await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("sortDir=desc")
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Page 2", exact: true }).click()
    await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("page=2")
    expect(state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("sortBy=reference")
    expect(state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("sortDir=desc")
    await page
      .getByRole("combobox", { name: "Filter requests", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Cancelled", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Showing 1–1 of 1")).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText("SR-INBOX-12", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    expect(state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("page=1")
    await page
      .getByRole("combobox", { name: "Filter requests", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Closed", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByText("No requests match this view.", { exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("combobox", { name: "Filter requests", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page
      .getByRole("option", { name: "All statuses", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Showing 1–10 of 12")).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Sort by service", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("sortBy=service")
    for (const [column, label] of [
      ["service", "service"],
      ["reference", "reference"],
      ["client", "client"],
      ["status", "status"],
      ["createdAt", "date requested"],
    ] as const) {
      if (column !== "service") {
        await page
          .getByRole("button", { name: `Sort by ${label}`, exact: true })
          .click()
      }
      await expect
        .poll(() => state.queries.at(-1))
        .toContain(`sortBy=${column}`)
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("columnheader", { name: new RegExp(label, "i") }),
      ).toHaveAttribute("aria-sort", "ascending")
      await page
        .getByRole("button", {
          name: `Sort by ${label}, ascending`,
          exact: true,
        })
        .click()
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("columnheader", { name: new RegExp(label, "i") }),
      ).toHaveAttribute("aria-sort", "descending")
      await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("sortDir=desc")
    }
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Page 2", exact: true }).click()
    await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("page=2")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", {
        name: "Sort by date requested, descending",
        exact: true,
      })
      .click()
    await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("page=1")
    await page.screenshot({
      path: `test-results/issue142-inbox-${width}.png`,
      fullPage: true,
    })
    expect(
      await page.evaluate(
        () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth,
      ),
    ).toBe(true)
  })

test(`failed delete preserves the booking after cancellation and retry at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 920 })
    const state = await mockInbox(page)
    await page.goto("/request-inbox")
    const review = page.getByRole("button", {
      name: "Review request booking-1",
      exact: true,
    })
    const label = "Delete request"
    const trigger = page.getByRole("button", {
      name: "Delete request booking-1",
      exact: true,
    })

    await trigger.click()
    const confirmation = page.getByRole("dialog", {
      name: "Delete this request?",
    })
    await expect(confirmation).toContainText("Website Development")
    await confirmation
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel", exact: true })
      .click()
    expect(state.mutations).toEqual([])
    await trigger.click()
    state.mutationError = 503
    const confirm = confirmation.getByRole("button", {
      name: label,
      exact: true,
    })
    await confirm.click()
    await expect.poll(() => state.mutations.length).toBe(1)
    await expect(confirm).toBeEnabled()
    expect(state.requests[0].status).toBe("SUBMITTED")
    expect(state.requests).toHaveLength(11)
    state.mutationError = 404
    await confirm.click()
    await expect(confirmation).not.toBeVisible()
    expect(state.mutations).toEqual(
      Array(2).fill("DELETE /api/request-inbox/booking-1"),
    )
    expect(state.requests[0].status).toBe("SUBMITTED")
    expect(state.requests).toHaveLength(11)
    await page.reload()
    await expect(page.getByText("Showing 1–10 of 11")).toBeVisible()
    await expect(review).toBeVisible()
  })

    if (width === 390)
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Open navigation menu" }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("link", { name: "Request Inbox", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("aria-current", "page")

      drawer.getByRole("button", { name: "Accepting…" }),

test("head can retry failures and a concurrent acceptance refreshes stale details", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const state = await mockInbox(page)
  state.listError = true
  await page.goto("/request-inbox")
  await expect(page.getByText("Inbox temporarily unavailable.")).toBeVisible()
  state.listError = false
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" }).click()
  state.detailsError = true
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Review request booking-1", exact: true })
    .click()
  await expect(page.getByText("Details temporarily unavailable.")).toBeVisible()
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("button", { name: "Accept request", exact: true }),
  ).toHaveCount(0)
  state.detailsError = false
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" }).click()
  state.acceptError = 503
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Accept request", exact: true })
    .click()
  const drawer = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Booking details" })
  await expect(drawer.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
    "Could not save acceptance. Try again.",
  )
  await expect(
    drawer.getByRole("button", { name: "Accept request", exact: true }),
  ).toBeEnabled()
  state.acceptError = 409
  await drawer
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Accept request", exact: true })
    .click()
  await expect(
    drawer.getByText(
      "Another department accepted this request. Its conversation is private to that department and the client.",
      {
        exact: true,
      },
    ),
  ).toBeVisible()
  await expect(
    drawer.getByRole("button", { name: "Accept request", exact: true }),
  ).toHaveCount(0)
  expect(state.accepts).toBe(2)
})

test(`quotation form formats amounts and uses custom date and time controls at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
    await page.clock.install({ time: new Date("2026-11-06T08:00:00Z") })
    const workflow = fixture()
    workflow.state = "QUOTATION_PENDING"
    workflow.quotations = []
    workflow.events = []
    workflow.paymentRequired = true
    workflow.permissions.manage = true
    workflow.permissions.isClient = false
    const actions = await mock(page, workflow, true)
    await page.goto("/messages?request=request-1")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Open request actions", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page
      .getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Create quotation", exact: true })
      .click()
    await chooseToolBooking(page)
    const chat = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Request conversation" })
    const draft = chat.getByRole("region", { name: "Prepare quotation" })
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Create quotation", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    const message = chat.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Message", exact: true })
    await message.fill("Quotation details stay connected to this chat.")
    await expect(message).toHaveValue(
      "Quotation details stay connected to this chat.",
    )
    const sheetBox = await draft.boundingBox()
    const composerBox = await chat
      .getByRole("form", { name: "Send a message" })
      .boundingBox()
    expect(
      Math.abs(composerBox!.y - (sheetBox!.y + sheetBox!.height) - 8),
    ).toBeLessThan(2)
    expect(sheetBox!.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(400)
    const details = page.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Request context" })
    await expect(details).toBeVisible()
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    const deliverables = draft.getByLabel("Deliverables (one per line)")
    await expect(deliverables).toBeFocused()
    await expect(deliverables).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true")
    await expect(deliverables).toHaveAccessibleDescription(
      "Complete this field.",
    )
    await expect(draft.locator("[data-field-error]")).toHaveText(
      "Complete this field.",
    )
    await expect(draft.locator("form")).toHaveAttribute("novalidate", "")
    expect(actions).toHaveLength(0)
    await draft
      .getByLabel("Deliverables (one per line)")
      .fill("Accessible website\nProduction deployment")
    await expect(deliverables).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true")
    await expect(draft.locator("[data-field-error]")).toHaveCount(0)
    await chat
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Hide service details", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(draft).toBeVisible()
    await chat
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Show service details", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(details).toBeVisible()
    await expect(draft.getByLabel("Deliverables (one per line)")).toHaveValue(
      "Accessible website\nProduction deployment",
    )
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await draft.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Currency", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("option", { name: "USD · US Dollar", exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("option", { name: "USD · US Dollar", exact: true })
      .click()
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    const item = draft.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Item 1", exact: true })
    await expect(item).toBeFocused()
    await expect(item).toHaveAccessibleDescription("Complete this field.")
    await expect(item).toBeInViewport()
    await expect(draft.locator("[data-field-error]")).toBeInViewport()
    await expect
      .poll(() =>
        draft.locator("[data-field-error]").evaluate((element) => {
          const box = element.getBoundingClientRect()
          return (
            document.elementFromPoint(
              box.x + box.width / 2,
              box.y + box.height / 2,
            ) === element
          )
        }),
      )
      .toBe(true)
    await page.screenshot({
      path: `test-results/quotation-validation-${width}.png`,
    })
    await item.fill("Website delivery")
    const quantity = draft.getByRole("spinbutton", {
      name: "Quantity",
      exact: true,
    })
    await quantity.fill("0")
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(quantity).toBeFocused()
    await expect(quantity).toHaveAccessibleDescription(
      "Enter a value of 1 or more.",
    )
    await quantity.fill("1")
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    const price = draft.getByLabel("Unit price", { exact: true })
    await expect(price).toBeFocused()
    await expect(price).toHaveAccessibleDescription("Complete this field.")
    await price.pressSequentially("1234567.89", { delay: 20 })
    await expect(price).toHaveValue("1,234,567.89")
    await expect(draft.locator("[data-field-error]")).toHaveCount(0)
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await draft
      .getByLabel("Payment terms", { exact: true })
      .fill("Deposit before commencement, balance on delivery.")
    const amount = draft.getByLabel("Amount due before commencement", {
      exact: true,
    })
    await amount.fill("1234.5")
    await expect(amount).toHaveValue("1,234.5")
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Review", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(draft.getByRole("alert")).toContainText(
      "Choose a future validity date",
    )
    await expect(amount).toHaveValue("1,234.50")
    const validity = draft.getByRole("button", {
      name: "Valid until",
      exact: true,
    })
    const amountBox = await amount.boundingBox()
    const dateBox = await validity.boundingBox()
    expect(
      Math.abs(amountBox!.y + amountBox!.height - dateBox!.y - dateBox!.height),
    ).toBeLessThan(1)
    expect(Math.abs(amountBox!.height - dateBox!.height)).toBeLessThan(1)
    expect(Math.abs(amountBox!.width - dateBox!.width)).toBeLessThan(1)
    await expect(validity).toHaveText("Select date & time")
    expect(dateBox!.x).toBeGreaterThan(amountBox!.x + amountBox!.width)
    await validity.click()
    const picker = page.getByRole("dialog", {
      name: "Select date and time",
      exact: true,
    })
    await expect(
      picker.getByRole("button", { name: "Previous month", exact: true }),
    ).toBeDisabled()
    await expect(
      picker.getByRole("button", {
        name: "Sunday, November 1, 2026",
        exact: true,
      }),
    ).toBeDisabled()
    await picker
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Friday, November 20, 2026", exact: true })
      .click()
    await picker.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Hour", exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "09", exact: true }).click()
    await picker.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Minute", exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "30", exact: true }).click()
    await picker.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Period", exact: true }).click()

    await expect(draft.locator('input[name="validUntil"]')).toHaveValue(
      "2026-11-20T09:30",
    )
    await page.screenshot({
      path: `test-results/quotation-terms-${width}.png`,
    })
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Review", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      draft.getByRole("region", { name: "Quotation review" }),
    ).toContainText("1,234,567.89")
    await draft
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Send quotation", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect.poll(() => actions.length).toBe(1)
    expect(actions[0]).toMatchObject({
      type: "CREATE_QUOTATION",
      currency: "USD",
      lineItems: [
        {
          description: "Website delivery",
          quantity: 1,
          unitPrice: "1234567.89",
        },
      ],
      paymentDue: "1234.50",
    })
    expect(
      await page.evaluate(
        () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth,
      ),
    ).toBe(true)
  })

test("declining a quotation requires confirmation and cancel preserves it", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const actions = await mock(page, fixture())
  await page.goto("/messages?request=request-1")
  await page
    .getByRole("checkbox", { name: /I have reviewed this quotation/ })
    .check()
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Decline quotation", exact: true })
    .click()
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Decline quotation?" })
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
  expect(actions).toHaveLength(0)
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel", exact: true }).click()
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  expect(actions).toHaveLength(0)
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Decline quotation", exact: true })
    .click()
  await dialog
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm decline", exact: true })
    .click()
  await expect.poll(() => actions.length).toBe(1)
  expect(actions[0]).toMatchObject({ decision: "DECLINE" })
})

test("department heads can confirm payment or reject it with a required reason", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const workflow = fixture()
  workflow.state = "AGREEMENT_PAYMENT_PENDING"
  workflow.permissions = {
    manage: true,
    isClient: false,
    approveQuotation: false,
    verifyPayment: false,
  }
  workflow.agreement = {
    id: "agreement-1",
    mandatory: true,
    status: "APPROVED",
    documentFileId: null,
    signedFileId: null,
  }
  workflow.payment = {
    id: "payment-1",
    mandatory: true,
    amount: "12500.00",
    currency: "PHP",
    status: "SUBMITTED",
    proofFileId: null,
    reference: "BANK-123",
  }
  workflow.internal = {
    staff: [],
    approvers: [{ id: "admin-1", fullName: "Finance Reviewer" }],
    quotationApproverId: "quotation-admin",
    paymentVerifierId: null,
    events: [],
  }
  workflow.events = [
    {
      id: "payment-submitted",
      type: "PAYMENT_SUBMITTED",
      summary: "Payment proof submitted",
      entityId: "payment-1",
      createdAt: "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
      actor: null,
    },
  ]
  const actions = await mock(page, workflow, true)
  await page.goto("/messages?request=request-1")
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Reject payment", exact: true })
    .click()
  expect(actions).toHaveLength(0)
  await expect(page.locator("[data-field-error]")).toHaveText(
    "Enter a reason for rejecting this payment.",
  )
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Verification note", exact: true }),
  ).toBeFocused()
  await page
    .getByRole("textbox", { name: "Verification note", exact: true })
    .fill("Receipt does not match the amount")
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Reject payment", exact: true })
    .click()
  await expect.poll(() => actions.length).toBe(1)
  expect(actions[0]).toMatchObject({
    type: "VERIFY_PAYMENT",
    approve: false,
    note: "Receipt does not match the amount",
  })
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm payment", exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible()
  await page.getByLabel("Verification note", { exact: true }).fill("")
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm payment", exact: true })
    .click()
  await expect.poll(() => actions.length).toBe(2)
  expect(actions[1]).toMatchObject({
    type: "VERIFY_PAYMENT",
    approve: true,
    note: "",
  })
})

    async ({ page }) => {

      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Open request actions", exact: true })
        .click()
      await nextTool.click()
      await chooseToolBooking(page)
      await expect(
        setup.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /Dani Worker/ }),
      ).not.toBeChecked()
      await setup.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /Dani Worker/ }).check()
      await page.screenshot({
        path: `test-results/project-staffing-modal-${width}.png`,
        fullPage: true,

      await setup
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Approve staffing", exact: true })

        "Staffing temporarily unavailable",

      await setup
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Approve staffing", exact: true })

      expect(staffingAttempts[0]!.actionId).toBe(staffingAttempts[1]!.actionId)
      await expect(activate).toBeEnabled()
      expect(actions).toHaveLength(2)

        fullPage: true,
      })
      await activate.click()
      await expect(setup).toHaveCount(0)
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("button", {
          name: "Set up project workspace",

        }),
      ).toHaveCount(0)
      await expect.poll(() => actions.length).toBe(3)
      expect(actions[0]).toMatchObject({

      expect(actions[1]).toMatchObject({

        employeeIds: ["employee-1", "employee-2"],
      })

  )

test("preserves client sorting, filtering, actions, states, and accessibility", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 })
    const state = await mockClientTable(page, true)
    await page.goto("/clients")

    const table = page.getByRole("table", { name: "Clients" })
    await expect(table).toHaveAttribute("aria-busy", "true")
    await expect(table.getByRole("status")).toHaveText("Loading clients…")

    state.releaseFirstRequest()
    await expect(table).toHaveAttribute("aria-busy", "false")
    await expect(table.getByText("Zeta Client", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      table.getByRole("columnheader", { name: /Date registered/i }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("aria-sort", "descending")

    await table.getByRole("button", { name: /^Sort by Client name$/i }).click()
    await expect(
      table.getByRole("columnheader", { name: /Client name/i }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("aria-sort", "ascending")
    await expect(table.getByRole("row").nth(1)).toContainText("Alpha Client")

    const search = page.getByRole("searchbox", { name: "Search clients" })
    await search.fill("alpha")
    await expect(table.getByText("Alpha Client", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await expect(table.getByText("Zeta Client", { exact: true })).toHaveCount(0)
    await search.fill("missing client")
    await expect(
      table.getByRole("status").filter({ hasText: "missing client" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear filters" }).click()

    state.failNextRequest()
    await table
      .getByRole("button", { name: /^Sort by Email address$/i })
      .click()
    await expect(table.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
      /Client directory temporarily unavailable/,
    )
    await table.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" }).click()
    await expect(table.getByText("Alpha Client", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()

    const view = table.getByRole("button", {
      name: "View Alpha Client",
      exact: true,
    })
    await view.click()
    const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog")
    await expect(dialog).toContainText("Alpha Client")
    await dialog
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Close client details", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(view).toBeFocused()
  })

test("service wizard persists consultation and single recurring pricing after reload", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN")
    await page.goto("/services")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog")
    const selectStep = (name: string) =>
      dialog
        .getByRole("navigation", { name: "Service form progress" })
        .getByRole("button", { name })
        .click()
    await selectStep("Benefits")
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Add Benefit" }).click()
    await dialog.getByLabel("Benefit Title").fill("Launch with confidence")
    await dialog
      .getByLabel("Benefit Description")
      .fill("A guided process from discovery through delivery.")
    await page.mouse.click(2, 2)
    await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Benefit Title")).toHaveValue(
      "Launch with confidence",
    )
    await selectStep("Requirements")
    await dialog
      .getByRole("textbox", { name: /Client Requirements/ })
      .fill("  Brand guide  \n\nProject brief")
    await dialog
      .getByLabel("Consultation is required before proceeding")
      .check()
    await dialog.getByLabel("Consultation Notes").fill("Discuss project scope")
    await selectStep("Pricing")
    await dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }).click()
    await page
      .getByRole("option", { name: "Create a reusable template" })
      .click()
    await dialog
      .getByLabel("Template Name", { exact: true })
      .fill("Monthly support")
    await dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Model", { exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Recurring", exact: true }).click()
    await dialog.getByLabel("Amount (PHP)").fill("1500.50")
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    await expect(dialog.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
      "Select a billing interval",
    )
    await dialog.getByLabel("Billing Interval").click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Monthly", exact: true }).click()
    const saved = page.waitForRequest(
      (request) =>
        request.method() === "PUT" &&
        new URL(request.url()).pathname === "/api/services/service-1",
    )
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    expect((await saved).postDataJSON()).toMatchObject({
      clientRequirements: ["Brand guide", "Project brief"],
      requiresConsultation: true,
      consultationNotes: "Discuss project scope",
      keyBenefits: [
        {
          title: "Launch with confidence",
          description: "A guided process from discovery through delivery.",
        },
      ],
      pricingTemplateId: null,
      pricingTemplate: {
        name: "Monthly support",
        pricingModel: "RECURRING",
        amount: 1500.5,
        currency: "PHP",
        billingInterval: "MONTHLY",
        isPublic: true,
      },
      packages: [],
    })
    await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
    await page.reload()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "View Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    for (const text of [
      "Brand guide; Project brief",
      "Discuss project scope",
    ]) {
      await expect(dialog).toContainText(text)
    }
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Close details" }).click()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    await selectStep("Benefits")
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Benefit Title")).toHaveValue(
      "Launch with confidence",
    )
    await selectStep("Requirements")
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Consultation Notes")).toHaveValue(
      "Discuss project scope",
    )
    await dialog
      .getByLabel("Consultation is required before proceeding")
      .uncheck()
    await selectStep("Pricing")
    await expect(
      dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }),
    ).toContainText("Monthly support")
    await selectStep("Options")
    await expect(dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Pricing/ })).toBeChecked()
    await expect(
      dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Packages/ }),
    ).not.toBeChecked()
    await expect(
      dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    const updated = page.waitForRequest(
      (request) =>
        request.method() === "PUT" &&
        new URL(request.url()).pathname === "/api/services/service-1",
    )
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    expect((await updated).postDataJSON()).toMatchObject({
      requiresConsultation: false,
      consultationNotes: null,
      pricingTemplateId: "pricing-1",
      pricingTemplate: null,
      packages: [],
    })
    await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  })

test("service packages are exclusive with pricing and can be replaced during editing", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN")
    await page.goto("/services")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog")
    const selectStep = (name: string) =>
      dialog
        .getByRole("navigation", { name: "Service form progress" })
        .getByRole("button", { name })
        .click()
    await selectStep("Pricing")
    await dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }).click()
    await page
      .getByRole("option", { name: "Create a reusable template" })
      .click()
    // An unfinished draft in the other mode must not block saving packages.
    await selectStep("Options")
    await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Packages/ }).check()
    await expect(
      dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Package Name")).toHaveCount(2)
    await expect(
      dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    for (const [index, name] of ["Starter", "Premium"].entries()) {
      await dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").nth(index).fill(name)
      await dialog
        .getByLabel("Description", { exact: true })
        .nth(index)
        .fill(`${name} support package`)
      await dialog
        .getByLabel("Included Features")
        .nth(index)
        .fill(" Email support \n\nMonthly review")
    }
    await dialog.getByLabel("Recommended", { exact: true }).first().check()
    await dialog
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Remove", exact: true })
      .last()
      .click()
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    await expect(dialog.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
      "Add at least two packages, or choose Pricing for a single option",
    )
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Add Package" }).click()
    await dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").last().fill("Premium")
    await dialog
      .getByLabel("Description", { exact: true })
      .last()
      .fill("Premium support package")
    await dialog.getByLabel("Included Features").last().fill("Priority support")
    const saved = page.waitForRequest(
      (request) =>
        request.method() === "PUT" &&
        new URL(request.url()).pathname === "/api/services/service-1",
    )
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    expect((await saved).postDataJSON()).toMatchObject({
      pricingTemplateId: null,
      pricingTemplate: null,
      packages: [
        expect.objectContaining({
          name: "Starter",
          includedFeatures: ["Email support", "Monthly review"],
          isRecommended: true,
        }),
        expect.objectContaining({ name: "Premium" }),
      ],
    })
    await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
    await page.reload()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    await selectStep("Options")
    await expect(dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Packages/ })).toBeChecked()
    await selectStep("Packages")
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").first()).toHaveValue(
      "Starter",
    )
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").last()).toHaveValue(
      "Premium",
    )
    // Invalid package drafts must not block switching back to single pricing.
    await dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").first().fill("")
    await selectStep("Options")
    await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Pricing/ }).check()
    await selectStep("Pricing")
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Package Name")).toHaveCount(0)
    const updated = page.waitForRequest(
      (request) =>
        request.method() === "PUT" &&
        new URL(request.url()).pathname === "/api/services/service-1",
    )
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    expect((await updated).postDataJSON()).toMatchObject({ packages: [] })
    await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
    await page.reload()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    await selectStep("Options")
    await expect(dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Pricing/ })).toBeChecked()
  })

test(`service creation with ${offering} validates department selection and preserves rejected edits`, async ({
      page,
    }) => {
      await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN")
      await page.goto("/services")
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Create Service", exact: true })
        .click()
      const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog")
      await dialog.getByLabel("Service Name").fill("Consulting")
      await dialog
        .getByLabel("Description", { exact: false })
        .fill("Business consulting")
      await dialog
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Continue", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(dialog.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
        "Please select at least one responsible department",
      )
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Select responsible departments" })
        .click()
      await page.getByRole("menuitemcheckbox", { name: "Engineering" }).click()
      await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
      for (let step = 0; step < 3; step++) {
        await dialog
          .getByRole("button", { name: "Continue", exact: true })
          .click()
      }
      await expect(
        dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Pricing/ }),
      ).not.toBeChecked()
      await dialog
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Continue", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(dialog.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
        "Choose Pricing or Packages to continue",
      )
      await dialog
        .getByRole("radio", { name: new RegExp(`^${offering}`) })
        .check()
      await dialog
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Continue", exact: true })
        .click()
      if (offering === "Packages") {
        for (const [index, name] of ["Starter", "Premium"].entries()) {
          await dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").nth(index).fill(name)
          await dialog
            .getByLabel("Description", { exact: true })
            .nth(index)
            .fill(`${name} consulting`)
          await dialog
            .getByLabel("Included Features")
            .nth(index)
            .fill("Business analysis")
        }
      }
      const created = page.waitForRequest(
        (request) =>
          request.method() === "POST" &&
          new URL(request.url()).pathname === "/api/services",
      )
      await dialog
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Create Service", exact: true })
        .click()
      expect((await created).postDataJSON()).toEqual({
        name: "Consulting",
        description: "Business consulting",
        iconKey: "sparkles",
        departmentIds: ["dept-1"],
        isActive: true,
        imageDataUrl: null,
        imageAltText: null,
        removeImage: false,
        clientRequirements: [],
        requiresConsultation: false,
        requiresAgreement: true,
        requiresPayment: true,
        requiresQuotationApproval: false,
        consultationNotes: null,
        keyBenefits: [],
        pricingTemplateId: null,
        pricingTemplate: null,
        packages:
          offering === "Packages"
            ? [
                expect.objectContaining({
                  name: "Starter",
                  includedFeatures: ["Business analysis"],
                }),
                expect.objectContaining({
                  name: "Premium",
                  includedFeatures: ["Business analysis"],
                }),
              ]
            : [],
      })
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("rowheader", { name: "Consulting", exact: true }),
      ).toBeVisible()
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Consulting", exact: true })
        .click()
      await dialog.getByLabel("Service Name").fill("Updated Consulting")
      await page.route("**/api/services/service-2", (route) =>
        route.fulfill({ status: 403, json: { error: "Permission revoked" } }),
      )
      const updates: string[] = []
      page.on("request", (request) => {
        if (
          request.method() === "PUT" &&

        page.getByRole("rowheader", { name: "Consulting", exact: true }),
      ).toBeVisible()
      if (offering === "Packages") {
        await page.unroute("**/api/services/service-2")

          .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Consulting", exact: true })
          .click()
        await dialog
          .getByRole("navigation", { name: "Service form progress" })
          .getByRole("button", { name: "5 Packages", exact: true })
          .click()
        const premium = dialog.getByRole("article").filter({

          .getByRole("button", { name: "Remove", exact: true })

        await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Package Name")).toHaveValue("Starter")

          .getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes", exact: true })
          .click()

        )
        expect(updates).toHaveLength(1)
        await dialog
          .getByRole("button", { name: "Add Package", exact: true })
          .click()
        await dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").nth(1).fill("Replacement")
        await dialog
          .getByLabel("Description", { exact: true })
          .nth(1)
          .fill("Replacement consulting")
        await dialog
          .getByLabel("Included Features")
          .nth(1)
          .fill("Business analysis")
        const update = page.waitForRequest(

        )
        await dialog
          .getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes", exact: true })
          .click()

          packages: { name: string }[]
        }
        expect(body.packages.map((item) => item.name)).toEqual([
          "Starter",
          "Replacement",

        await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
        await page
          .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Consulting", exact: true })
          .click()

          .getByRole("button", { name: "5 Packages", exact: true })

        await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").nth(0)).toHaveValue(
          "Starter",

        await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").nth(1)).toHaveValue(
          "Replacement",

test(`superadmin can restore a soft-deleted account at ${width}px`, async ({
      page,
    }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
      await restoreSession(page, "SUPERADMIN", {
        initialUsers: [
          {
            ...accountFor("USER"),
            id: "trashed-target",
            email: "target@example.com",
            fullName: "Target User",
            isActive: false,
            accountDeletedAt: "2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z",
          },
        ],
      })
      let attempts = 0
      let releaseRestore: (() => void) | undefined
      await page.route("**/api/users/trashed-target/restore", async (route) => {
        attempts += 1
        expect(route.request().method()).toBe("POST")
        expect(route.request().headers().authorization).toBe(
          "Bearer test-session",
        )
        if (attempts === 1) {
          await route.fulfill({
            status: 503,
            json: { error: "Restore failed. Please retry." },
          })
          return
        }
        await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
          releaseRestore = resolve
        })
        await route.fallback()
      })
      await page.goto("/accounts")
      await expect(page.getByText("Target User")).toBeHidden()
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Trash", exact: true }).click()
      await expect(page.getByText("Target User")).toBeVisible()
      const openRestore = async () => {
        await page
          .getByRole("button", { name: "More actions for target@example.com" })
          .click()
        await page
          .getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Restore account", exact: true })
          .click()
      }
      await openRestore()
      const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog")
      await expect(
        dialog.getByRole("heading", { name: "Restore account?" }),
      ).toBeVisible()
      await expect(dialog).toContainText("as inactive")
      await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel", exact: true }).click()
      expect(attempts).toBe(0)
      await openRestore()
      await dialog
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Restore account", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(dialog.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
        "Restore failed. Please retry.",
      )
      await dialog
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Restore account", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(
        dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Restoring...", exact: true }),
      ).toBeDisabled()
      await expect(
        dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel", exact: true }),
      ).toBeDisabled()
      await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
      await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
      await expect.poll(() => Boolean(releaseRestore)).toBe(true)
      releaseRestore?.()
      await expect(dialog).toBeHidden()
      await expect(page.getByText("Target User")).toBeHidden()
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Back to Accounts", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(page.getByText("Target User")).toBeVisible()
      await expect(page.getByText("Inactive", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "More actions for target@example.com" })
        .click()
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Restore account", exact: true }),
      ).toBeHidden()
      await page
        .getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Reactivate account", exact: true })
        .click()
      await page
        .getByRole("dialog")
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Reactivate account", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(page.getByText("Active", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
      expect(attempts).toBe(2)
    })

  for (const directory of [
    {
      path: "/clients",
      endpoint: "/api/clients",
      key: "clients",
      role: "ADMIN",
      search: "Search clients",
    },
    {
      path: "/employees",
      endpoint: "/api/employees",
      key: "employees",
      role: "ADMIN",
      search: "Search employees",
    },
    {
      path: "/booked-services",
      endpoint: "/api/service-requests",
      key: "serviceRequests",
      role: "USER",
      search: "Search booked services",
    },
    {
      path: "/request-inbox",
      endpoint: "/api/request-inbox",
      key: "serviceRequests",
      role: "STAFF",
      search: "Search requests",
    },
    {
      path: "/service-requests",
      endpoint: "/api/client/service-requests",
      key: "requests",
      role: "USER",
      search: "Search service requests",
    },
  ] as const) {
    test(`${directory.path} previews and clears search before responses at ${width}px`, async ({
      page,
    }, testInfo) => {
      test.skip(live, "Uses isolated table fixtures")
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
      await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "no-preference" })
      await restoreSession(page, directory.role, {
        account: { headOf: { id: "dept-1", name: "Engineering" } },
      })
      const records = [
        fixture("Alpha Table", "alpha"),
        fixture("Beta Table", "beta"),
      ]
      if (directory.key === "employees")
        records.forEach((item) => {
          item.status = "ACTIVE"
        })
      let hold = false
      let release = () => {}
      const barrier = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        release = resolve
      })
      await page.route(`**${directory.endpoint}?**`, async (route) => {
        const query =
          new URL(route.request().url()).searchParams
            .get("search")
            ?.toLowerCase() ?? ""
        if (hold) await barrier
        const source =
          query === "remote" ? [fixture("Remote Table", "remote")] : records
        const rows = source.filter((item) =>
          item.fullName.toLowerCase().includes(query),
        )
        await route.fulfill({
          json: {
            [directory.key]: rows,
            total: rows.length,
            page: 1,
            pageSize: 10,
            department: { id: "dept-1", name: "Engineering" },
            summary: {
              total: 2,
              pending: 2,
              inProgress: 0,
              completed: 0,
              cancelled: 0,
            },
          },
        })
      })
      await page.goto(directory.path)
      const rows = page.locator(
        '[data-animated-slot-row][aria-hidden="false"]:visible',
      )
      await expect(rows).toHaveCount(2)
      const search = page.getByRole("searchbox", {
        name: directory.search,
        exact: true,
      })
      hold = true
      try {
        await search.fill("Alpha")
        await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1)
        await expect(rows).toContainText("Alpha Table")
        await search.fill("")
        await expect(rows).toHaveCount(2)
        await search.fill("Bet")
        await search.pressSequentially("a")
        await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1)
        await expect(rows).toContainText("Beta Table")
        await search.fill("Remote")
        await expect(rows).toHaveCount(0)
        await expect(page.getByText(/^Searching all/)).toBeVisible()
        release()
        await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1)
        await expect(rows).toContainText("Remote Table")
        await expect(page.getByText(/^Searching all/)).toHaveCount(0)
        await rows.first().scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
        await page.screenshot({
          path: testInfo.outputPath("settled-table.png"),
        })
      } finally {
        release()
      }
    })
  }
}

tests.title: route utilities stay styled across auth and portal navigation
tests.testSource:
test("route utilities stay styled across auth and portal navigation", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" })
  await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN")
  await page.goto("/login")
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard$/)
  const dashboard = page.getByRole("main", { name: "Dashboard", exact: true })
  await expect(dashboard).toHaveCSS("border-radius", "13px")
  await expect(dashboard).toHaveCSS("background-color", "rgb(243, 247, 249)")

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign Out", exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/)
  await expect(page.locator("main[lang]")).toHaveCSS("display", "grid")
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 })
  await expect(page.locator("main[lang]")).toHaveCSS("display", "block")
  await expect(page.locator("aside")).toBeHidden()
})

test(`client package card sizing with ${packageCount} packages at ${width}px`, async ({
        page,
      }, testInfo) => {
        await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 1000 })
        const timestamp = "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
        await restoreSession(page, "USER", {
          initialServices: [
            {
              id: "layout-service",
              name: "Layout Service",
              description: "Support for your next project.",
              iconKey: "sparkles",
              imageUrl: null,
              imageAltText: null,
              clientRequirements: [],
              requiresConsultation: false,
              consultationNotes: null,
              keyBenefits: [],
              isActive: true,
              pricingTemplateId: null,
              pricingTemplate: null,
              departments: [],
              createdAt: timestamp,
              updatedAt: timestamp,
              packages: Array.from({ length: packageCount }, (_, index) => ({
                id: `package-${index}`,
                name: `Package ${index + 1}`,
                description: "Project support.",
                includedFeatures: ["Dedicated specialist"],
                pricingModel: "CUSTOM_QUOTE",
                currency: "PHP",
                amount: null,
                billingInterval: null,
                isPricingPublic: false,
                isActive: true,
                isRecommended: index === 0,
                displayOrder: index,
                createdAt: timestamp,
                updatedAt: timestamp,
              })),
            },
          ],
        })
        await page.goto("/services")
        await page
          .getByRole("button", { name: "Explore Layout Service" })
          .click()
        await page
          .getByRole("dialog")
          .getByRole("button", { name: "EXPlore", exact: true })
          .click()
        const cards = page
          .getByRole("group", { name: "Packages & pricing" })
          .getByRole("article")
        await expect(cards).toHaveCount(Math.max(1, packageCount))
        const bounds = await cards.evaluateAll((elements) =>
          elements.map((element) => {
            const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect()
            return {
              width: rect.width,
              height: rect.height,
              overflow: element.scrollWidth > element.clientWidth,
            }
          }),
        )
        for (const card of bounds) {
          expect(card.width).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(280)
          expect(card.width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(331)
          expect(card.height).toBeLessThan(500)
          expect(card.overflow).toBe(false)
        }
        await cards.first().scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
        await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath("card-layout.png") })
      })

tests.title: client catalog retries failures and resets pagination when filtering
tests.testSource:
test("client catalog retries failures and resets pagination when filtering", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    const timestamp = "2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z"
    const services: Service[] = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, index) => ({
      id: `catalog-${index}`,
      name: `Catalog Service ${index + 1}`,
      description: "Business support",
      iconKey: "sparkles",
      imageUrl: null,
      imageAltText: null,
      clientRequirements: [],
      requiresConsultation: false,
      consultationNotes: null,
      keyBenefits: [],
      isActive: true,
      pricingTemplateId: null,
      pricingTemplate: null,
      packages: [],
      departments: [
        {
          id: index < 8 ? "engineering" : "marketing",
          name: index < 8 ? "Engineering" : "Marketing",
          code: null,
          color: "teal",
        },
      ],
      createdAt: timestamp,
      updatedAt: timestamp,
    }))
    await restoreSession(page, "USER", { initialServices: services })
    await page.route(
      "**/api/client/services",
      (route) =>
        route.fulfill({
          status: 503,
          json: { error: "Catalog temporarily unavailable" },
        }),
      { times: 1 },
    )
    await page.goto("/services")
    await expect(page.getByRole("main").getByRole("alert")).toContainText(
      "Catalog temporarily unavailable",
    )
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Explore Catalog Service/ }),
    ).toHaveCount(8)
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Next page", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Explore Catalog Service/ }),
    ).toHaveCount(2)
    await page
      .getByRole("combobox", { name: "Filter services by department" })
      .click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Engineering", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: "Page 1", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("aria-current", "page")
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Explore Catalog Service/ }),
    ).toHaveCount(8)
    await page
      .getByRole("searchbox", { name: "Search services" })
      .fill("' OR 1=1 --")
    await expect(
      page.getByText("No services found", { exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Explore Catalog Service/ }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await page
      .getByRole("searchbox", { name: "Search services" })
      .fill("Catalog Service 3")
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Explore Catalog Service/ }),
    ).toHaveCount(1)
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", {
        name: "Explore Catalog Service 3",
        exact: true,
      }),
    ).toBeVisible()
  })

tests.title: admin can create, edit, delete departments and open member management
tests.testSource:
test("admin can create, edit, delete departments and open member management", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN")
    await page.goto("/departments")

    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Department Management" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", { name: "Engineering", exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()

    // 1. Create a Department
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Create Department", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Create Department" }),
    ).toBeVisible()

    await page.getByLabel("Department Name").fill("Customer Support")
    await page.getByLabel("Department Code").fill("CS")
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("radiogroup", { name: "Department color" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole("radio", { name: "Green", exact: true }).click()
    const createdDepartment = page.waitForRequest(
      (request) =>
        request.method() === "POST" &&
        new URL(request.url()).pathname === "/api/departments",
    )
    await page
      .getByRole("dialog")
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Create Department" })
      .click()

    await expect(page.getByText("Customer Support")).toBeVisible()
    expect((await createdDepartment).postDataJSON()).toMatchObject({
      name: "Customer Support",
      color: "green",
    })
    await page.reload()

    // 2. Edit the Department
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Customer Support" }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Edit Department" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("radio", { name: "Green", exact: true }),
    ).toBeChecked()
    await page.getByLabel("Department Name").fill("Client Success")
    await page
      .getByRole("dialog")
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Update Department" })
      .click()

    await expect(page.getByText("Client Success")).toBeVisible()

    // 3. Open Member Management Sheet
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Client Success", exact: true })
      .click()

    // Member Management Drawer / Sheet opens
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Members & teams" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Close drawer" }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Members & teams" }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)

    // 4. Delete the Department
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "More actions for Client Success" })
      .click()
    await page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Delete department" }).click()

    await expect(page.getByText("Delete department?")).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Delete department", exact: true })
      .click()

    await expect(page.getByText("Client Success")).toHaveCount(0)
  })

test("employee search, details, and login retirement controls preserve HR records", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN")
    await page.goto("/employees")
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "View Alex Employee" }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole("dialog")).toContainText("EMP-001")
    await expect(page.getByRole("dialog")).toContainText(
      "alex.employee@example.com",
    )
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Close employee details" }).click()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "More actions for Alex Employee" })
      .click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Deactivate account" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Delete account", exact: true }),
    ).toBeDisabled()
    await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
    await page.getByPlaceholder("Search name, ID, email…").fill("EMP-001")
    await expect(page.getByText("Alex Employee", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  })
