tests.title: customizes shared templates and confirms deletion of unused templates at 1440px
tests.testSource:
test(`customizes shared templates and confirms deletion of unused templates at ${width}px`, async ({
      page,
    }, testInfo) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
      await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN", {
        initialServices: [{ ...service }],
        pricingTemplates: [{ ...sharedTemplate }, { ...unusedTemplate }],
      })
      await page.goto("/services")
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Pricing Templates", exact: true })
        .click()
      const manager = page.getByRole("dialog", {
        name: "Pricing Templates",
        exact: true,
      })
      await expect(manager).toContainText("Used by 1 service: Test Service")
      await expect(
        manager.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete Template", exact: true }),
      ).toBeDisabled()
      await manager
        .getByLabel("Template Name", { exact: true })
        .fill("Monthly support")
      await manager.getByLabel("Pricing Model", { exact: true }).click()
      await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Recurring", exact: true }).click()
      await manager.getByLabel("Amount (PHP)").fill("1500.50")
      await manager
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Save Template", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(manager.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
        "Select a billing interval",
      )
      await manager.getByLabel("Billing Interval").click()
      await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Monthly", exact: true }).click()
      await manager.getByLabel("Display pricing publicly").uncheck()
      const saved = page.waitForRequest(
        (request) =>
          request.method() === "PUT" &&
          new URL(request.url()).pathname ===
            "/api/services/pricing-templates/shared-pricing",
      )
      await manager
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Save Template", exact: true })
        .click()
      expect((await saved).postDataJSON()).toEqual({
        name: "Monthly support",
        pricingModel: "RECURRING",
        currency: "PHP",
        amount: 1500.5,
        billingInterval: "MONTHLY",
        isPublic: false,
      })
      await expect(
        manager.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }),
      ).toContainText("Monthly support")
      await page.screenshot({
        path: testInfo.outputPath(`pricing-template-${width}.png`),
      })
      await manager.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }).click()
      await page
        .getByRole("option", { name: "Unused pricing", exact: true })
        .click()
      await manager
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Delete Template", exact: true })
        .click()
      await manager
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel deletion", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(
        manager.getByLabel("Template Name", { exact: true }),
      ).toHaveValue("Unused pricing")
      await manager
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Delete Template", exact: true })
        .click()
      await manager
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Delete permanently", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(
        manager.getByLabel("Template Name", { exact: true }),
      ).toHaveValue("Monthly support")
      await manager
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Close pricing templates", exact: true })
        .click()
      await page.reload()
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
        .click()
      const serviceDialog = page.getByRole("dialog", {
        name: "Edit Service",
        exact: true,
      })
      await serviceDialog
        .getByLabel("Service Name")
        .fill("Unsubmitted service draft")
      await serviceDialog
        .getByRole("navigation", { name: "Service form progress" })
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Pricing" })
        .click()
      await expect(
        serviceDialog.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }),
      ).toContainText("Monthly support")
      await serviceDialog
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Customize template", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(manager.getByLabel("Amount (PHP)")).toHaveValue("1500.50")
      await expect(manager.getByLabel("Billing Interval")).toContainText(
        "Monthly",
      )

tests.testSource:
test("failed template changes preserve input and deletion can be retried", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN", {
      pricingTemplates: [{ ...unusedTemplate }],
    })
    await page.goto("/services")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Pricing Templates", exact: true })
      .click()
    const manager = page.getByRole("dialog", {
      name: "Pricing Templates",
      exact: true,
    })
    await manager
      .getByLabel("Template Name", { exact: true })
      .fill("Draft template name")
    await page.route(
      "**/api/services/pricing-templates/unused-pricing",
      (route) =>
        route.fulfill({ status: 403, json: { error: "Permission revoked" } }),
      { times: 1 },
    )
    await manager
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Save Template", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(manager.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText("Permission revoked")
    await expect(
      manager.getByLabel("Template Name", { exact: true }),
    ).toHaveValue("Draft template name")
    await manager
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Delete Template", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page.route(
      "**/api/services/pricing-templates/unused-pricing",
      (route) =>
        route.fulfill({
          status: 500,
          json: { error: "Temporary deletion failure" },
        }),
      { times: 1 },
    )
    await manager
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Delete permanently", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(manager.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
      "Temporary deletion failure",
    )
    await manager
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Delete permanently", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(manager).toContainText("No pricing templates yet")
  })

tests.title: an expired service update retries the same payload once after refresh
tests.testSource:
test("an expired service update retries the same payload once after refresh", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    let token = "test-session"
    let refreshes = 0
    const updates: ServiceInput[] = []
    await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN", { accessToken: () => token })
    await page.route("**/api/services/service-1", async (route) => {
      expect(route.request().method()).toBe("PUT")
      updates.push(route.request().postDataJSON() as ServiceInput)
      if (updates.length === 1)
        await route.fulfill({ status: 401, json: expiredAccess })
      else {
        expect(route.request().headers().authorization).toBe(
          `Bearer ${renewedTokens.token}`,
        )
        await route.fallback()
      }
    })
    await page.route("**/api/auth/refresh", async (route) => {
      refreshes++
      token = renewedTokens.token
      await route.fulfill({ json: renewedTokens })
    })
    await page.goto("/services")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page
      .getByRole("dialog")
      .getByLabel("Service Name")
      .fill("Renewed Service")
    await page
      .getByRole("dialog")
      .getByRole("navigation", { name: "Service form progress" })
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Pricing" })
      .click()
    await page
      .getByRole("dialog")
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(page.getByRole("dialog")).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("rowheader", { name: "Renewed Service", exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    expect(refreshes).toBe(1)
    expect(updates).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(updates[1]).toEqual(updates[0])
    expect(updates[1].name).toBe("Renewed Service")
  })

tests.title: registration keeps the existing API contract and opens the Client dashboard
tests.testSource:
test("registration keeps the existing API contract and opens the Client dashboard", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await mockApi(page, "USER")
    await page.goto("/register")
    await page.getByLabel("Full name", { exact: true }).fill("Test Person")
    await page.getByLabel("Contact number", { exact: true }).fill("09123456789")
    await page
      .getByLabel("Email address", { exact: true })
      .fill(testAccounts.USER.email)
    await page.getByLabel("Password", { exact: true }).fill("CorrectHorse123!")
    await page
      .getByLabel("Confirm Password", { exact: true })
      .fill("CorrectHorse123!")
    const submitted = page.waitForRequest("**/api/auth/register")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Create Account", exact: true })
      .click()
    expect((await submitted).postDataJSON()).toEqual({
      fullName: "Test Person",
      contactNumber: "09123456789",
      email: testAccounts.USER.email,
      password: "CorrectHorse123!",
    })
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard$/)
    await expect(page.locator('[data-role="USER"]')).toBeVisible()
    expect(await storedTokens(page)).toEqual(["test-session", "test-refresh"])
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("status", { name: "Opening your account" }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
  })

tests.title: client requests a reschedule for a general conversation meeting at 1440px
tests.testSource:
test(`client requests a reschedule for a general conversation meeting at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 920 })
    const state = sharedFixture()
    const startsAt = new Date(Date.now() + 86_400_000).toISOString()
    const meeting: ConversationMeeting = {
      id: "general-meeting",
      conversationId: "shared-design",
      startsAt,
      endsAt: new Date(Date.now() + 88_200_000).toISOString(),
      location: "Office",
      notes: "General catch-up",
      status: "SCHEDULED",
      version: 0,
      proposedStartsAt: null,
      rescheduleNote: null,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      bookings: [],
    }
    state.meetings.set("shared-design", [meeting])
    await mock(page, state, "USER")
    await page.route(
      "**/api/request-conversations/shared-design/meetings/general-meeting",
      async (route) => {
        const action = route.request().postDataJSON() as {
          type: string
          startsAt: string
          note: string
          expectedVersion: number
        }
        expect(action.type).toBe("REQUEST_RESCHEDULE")
        expect(action.expectedVersion).toBe(0)
        meeting.proposedStartsAt = action.startsAt
        meeting.rescheduleNote = action.note
        meeting.version++
        return route.fulfill({ json: { meeting } })
      },
    )
    await page.goto("/messages?request=shared-design")
    const log = page.getByRole("log", { name: "Conversation messages" })
    await log
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Request reschedule", exact: true })
      .click()
    const later = new Date(Date.now() + 2 * 86_400_000)
    await log
      .getByLabel("Requested date and time", { exact: true })
      .fill(
        new Date(later.getTime() - later.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000)
          .toISOString()
          .slice(0, 16),
      )
    await log
      .getByLabel("Reason for rescheduling", { exact: true })
      .fill("Please move our general catch-up")
    await log
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Send reschedule request", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(log).toContainText(
      "The existing schedule remains until the department head confirms a change.",
    )
    await expect(
      log.getByRole("button", { name: "Request reschedule", exact: true }),
    ).toBeDisabled()
    await expect(
      log.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel meeting", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    expect(meeting.startsAt).toBe(startsAt)
  })

tests.testSource:
test(`department head chooses a tool before its booking at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 920 })
    const state = sharedFixture()
    state.conversations![0]!.bookings![2]!.status = "CANCELLED"
    state.conversations![0]!.bookings![2]!.workflowState = "CANCELLED"
    state.conversations![0]!.bookings!.push({
      ...state.conversations![0]!.bookings![0]!,
      id: "agreement-booking",
      referenceNumber: "SR-104",
      workflowState: "AGREEMENT_PAYMENT_PENDING",
    })
    await mock(page, state, "STAFF")
    let failWorkflow = true
    await page.route("**/api/request-workflows/website", (route) =>
      failWorkflow
        ? route.fulfill({
            status: 503,
            json: { error: "Booking tools temporarily unavailable" },
          })
        : route.fallback(),
    )
    await page.goto("/messages?request=shared-design")
    const chat = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Request conversation" })
    const tools = chat.getByRole("button", {
      name: "Open request actions",
      exact: true,
    })
    await tools.click()
    const menu = page.getByRole("menu")
    await expect(menu.getByRole("radio")).toHaveCount(0)
    for (const name of [
      "Attach file",
      "Request information",
      "Schedule consultation/meeting",
      "Create quotation",
    ])
      await expect(
        menu.getByRole("menuitem", { name, exact: true }),
      ).toBeEnabled()
    await expect(menu.getByRole("menuitem")).toHaveCount(4)
    for (const name of [
      "Payment and commencement",
      "Approver assignments",
      "Internal notes",
      "Staffing and workload",
      "Workflow controls",
      "Project activation",
    ])
      await expect(
        menu.getByRole("menuitem", { name, exact: true }),
      ).toHaveCount(0)
    await menu
      .getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Create quotation", exact: true })
      .click()
    let context = page.getByRole("dialog", {
      name: "Create quotation: choose a booking",
    })
    const proceed = context.getByRole("button", {
      name: "Continue",
      exact: true,
    })
    await expect(proceed).toBeDisabled()
    await expect(context.locator("input:checked")).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(context.getByRole("radio")).toHaveCount(1)
    await expect(context).toContainText("Some services could not be checked.")
    failWorkflow = false
    await context
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Retry booking options", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(context.getByRole("radio")).toHaveCount(2)
    await context
      .getByRole("radio", { name: "Website SR-101", exact: true })
      .check()
    await expect(context).toContainText("Couldn't load tools for this booking.")
    await context
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Retry booking tools", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(proceed).toBeEnabled()
    await page.screenshot({
      path: `test-results/tool-booking-picker-${width}.png`,
      fullPage: true,
    })
    await proceed.click()
    const consultation = chat.getByRole("region", {
      name: "Prepare quotation",
      exact: true,
    })
    await expect(consultation).toContainText("Website · SR-101")
    await consultation
      .getByRole("button", {
        name: "Close prepare quotation draft",
        exact: true,
      })
      .click()
    await tools.click()
    await menu
      .getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Create quotation", exact: true })
      .click()
    context = page.getByRole("dialog", {
      name: "Create quotation: choose a booking",
    })
    await expect(context.locator("input:checked")).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(
      context.getByRole("radio", { name: "Website SR-103", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(
      context.getByRole("radio", { name: "Website SR-104", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(context.getByRole("radio")).toHaveCount(2)
    await expect(
      context.getByRole("button", { name: "Continue", exact: true }),
    ).toBeDisabled()
    await context
      .getByRole("radio", { name: "SEO SR-102", exact: true })
      .check()
    await context.getByRole("button", { name: "Continue", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      chat.getByRole("region", { name: "Prepare quotation", exact: true }),
    ).toContainText("SEO · SR-102")
    await expect(chat.getByRole("log").getByRole("article")).toHaveCount(4)
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/request=shared-design$/)
    await expect(
      chat.getByLabel("Message context", { exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
  })

test(`shared timeline keeps booking cards usable without selecting them at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 920 })
    const state = sharedFixture()
    await mock(page, state, "STAFF")
    const seo: Workflow = {
      request: {
        id: "seo",
        referenceNumber: "SR-102",
        title: "SEO request",
        serviceName: "SEO",
        packageName: null,
        pricingModel: "CUSTOM_QUOTE",
        goals: "Reach customers",
        requirements: "SEO requirements",
        expectedTimeline: "Six weeks",
        client: { id: "client-1", fullName: "Mara Client" },
        department: { id: "design", name: "Design" },
      },
      state: "AGREEMENT_PAYMENT_PENDING",
      previousState: null,
      version: 1,
      nextAction: "Verify payment",
      consultationRequired: false,
      quotationApprovalRequired: false,
      permissions: {
        manage: true,
        isClient: false,
        approveQuotation: false,
        verifyPayment: false,
      },
      requirements: [],
      consultations: [],
      quotations: [],
      approval: {
        quotationId: "seo-quote",
        amount: "1500.00",
        currency: "PHP",
        approvedById: "client-1",
        approvedAt: "2026-10-30T09:00:00Z",
      },
      internal: {
        staff: [],
        approvers: [],
        quotationApproverId: null,
        paymentVerifierId: null,
        events: [],
      },
      agreement: null,
      project: null,
      files: [
        {
          id: "seo-file",
          name: "seo-payment-receipt.pdf",
          mimeType: "application/pdf",
          size: 2048,
          uploaderId: "client-1",
          createdAt: "2026-10-30T10:10:00Z",
        },
      ],
      payment: {
        id: "seo-payment",
        mandatory: true,
        amount: "1500.00",
        currency: "PHP",
        status: "SUBMITTED",
        proofFileId: null,
        reference: "BANK-SEO",
      },
      events: [
        {
          id: "seo-file-event",
          type: "FILE_SUBMITTED",
          summary: "File submitted: seo-payment-receipt.pdf",
          entityId: "seo-file",
          createdAt: "2026-10-30T10:10:00Z",
          actor: null,
        },
        {
          id: "seo-payment-event",
          type: "PAYMENT_SUBMITTED",
          summary: "Payment evidence was submitted for manual verification.",
          entityId: "seo-payment",
          createdAt: "2026-10-30T10:15:00Z",
          actor: null,
        },
      ],
    }
    await page.route("**/api/request-workflows/seo", (route) =>
      route.fulfill({ json: seo }),
    )
    const actions: Record<string, unknown>[] = []
    await page.route("**/api/request-workflows/*/actions", (route) => {
      expect(new URL(route.request().url()).pathname).toBe(
        "/api/request-workflows/seo/actions",
      )
      actions.push(route.request().postDataJSON() as Record<string, unknown>)
      seo.version++
      seo.payment!.status = "VERIFIED"
      seo.state = "READY_FOR_ACTIVATION"
      return route.fulfill({ json: seo })
    })
    await page.goto("/messages?request=shared-design")
    const chat = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Request conversation" })
    const log = chat.getByRole("log", { name: "Conversation messages" })
    await expect(log.getByRole("article")).toHaveCount(4)
    await expect(
      log.getByRole("button", { name: "View booking", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(
      log.getByRole("article").getByRole("button", { name: /SR-10/ }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(
      log.getByRole("button", {
        name: "Download seo-payment-receipt.pdf",
        exact: true,
      }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(log.getByText("10/30/2026", { exact: true })).toHaveCount(1)
    await chat
      .getByLabel("Message", { exact: true })
      .fill("A shared reply stays here")
    await log
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm payment", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect.poll(() => actions.length).toBe(1)
    expect(actions[0]).toMatchObject({ type: "VERIFY_PAYMENT", approve: true })
    await expect(
      log.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm payment", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    const panel = page.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Request context" })
    await expect(panel.locator('button[aria-pressed="true"]')).toContainText(
      "SR-101",
    )
    const before = await log
      .locator('[data-booking-event="seo"]')
      .allTextContents()
    await chat
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Open request actions", exact: true })
      .click()
    const activation = page.getByRole("menuitem", {
      name: "Project activation",
      exact: true,
    })
    await expect(page.getByRole("menuitem").last()).toHaveText(
      "Project activation",
    )
    await activation.click()
    const picker = page.getByRole("dialog", {
      name: "Project activation: choose a booking",
      exact: true,
    })
    await picker.getByRole("radio", { name: "SEO SR-102", exact: true }).check()
    await picker.getByRole("button", { name: "Continue", exact: true }).click()
    const setup = page.getByRole("dialog", {
      name: "Activate project",
      exact: true,
    })
    await expect(setup).toContainText("SR-102")
    await expect(setup).toContainText(
      "No employees are assigned to this department.",
    )
    await expect(
      setup.getByRole("button", { name: "Approve staffing", exact: true }),
    ).toBeDisabled()
    await setup.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(panel.locator('button[aria-pressed="true"]')).toContainText(
      "SR-102",
    )
    expect(
      await log.locator('[data-booking-event="seo"]').allTextContents(),
    ).toEqual(before)
    await expect(chat.getByLabel("Message", { exact: true })).toHaveValue(
      "A shared reply stays here",
    )
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/request=shared-design$/)
    await page.screenshot({
      path: `test-results/shared-timeline-${width}.png`,
      fullPage: true,
    })
  })

tests.testSource:
test(`inbox rows refresh when a booking status changes elsewhere at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
    const state = await mockInbox(page)
    state.requests = [fixture(1)]
    await page.goto("/request-inbox")
    await expect(page.getByText("SR-INBOX-1", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    state.requests[0]!.status = "UNDER_REVIEW"
    state.requests[0]!.acceptedDepartmentId = "design"
    await expect(
      page.getByText("No requests match this view.", { exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10_000 })
    await page
      .getByRole("combobox", { name: "Filter requests", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page
      .getByRole("option", { name: "All statuses", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Under review", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    state.requests[0]!.status = "CLOSED"
    await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("focus")))
    await expect(page.getByText("Closed", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    expect(state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("view=all")
  })

tests.testSource:
test(`status filtering, sorting and exact-request chat feedback at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
    const state = await mockInbox(page)
    state.requests.forEach((request, index) => {
      request.service.name = index % 2 ? "Zebra service" : "Alpha service"
    })
    state.requests.push({ ...fixture(12), status: "CANCELLED" })
    await page.goto("/request-inbox")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", {
        name: "Go to chat for request booking-1",
        exact: true,
      })
      .click()
    await expect(
      page.getByText(
        "Accept this request for your department before opening its conversation.",
        { exact: true },
      ),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/request-inbox$/)
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Sort requests", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Sort by reference", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", {
        name: "Sort by reference, ascending",
        exact: true,
      })
      .click()
    await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("sortDir=desc")
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Page 2", exact: true }).click()
    await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("page=2")
    expect(state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("sortBy=reference")
    expect(state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("sortDir=desc")
    await page
      .getByRole("combobox", { name: "Filter requests", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Cancelled", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Showing 1–1 of 1")).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText("SR-INBOX-12", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    expect(state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("page=1")
    await page
      .getByRole("combobox", { name: "Filter requests", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Closed", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByText("No requests match this view.", { exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("combobox", { name: "Filter requests", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page
      .getByRole("option", { name: "All statuses", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Showing 1–10 of 12")).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Sort by service", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("sortBy=service")
    for (const [column, label] of [
      ["service", "service"],
      ["reference", "reference"],
      ["client", "client"],
      ["status", "status"],
      ["createdAt", "date requested"],
    ] as const) {
      if (column !== "service") {
        await page
          .getByRole("button", { name: `Sort by ${label}`, exact: true })
          .click()
      }
      await expect
        .poll(() => state.queries.at(-1))
        .toContain(`sortBy=${column}`)
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("columnheader", { name: new RegExp(label, "i") }),
      ).toHaveAttribute("aria-sort", "ascending")
      await page
        .getByRole("button", {
          name: `Sort by ${label}, ascending`,
          exact: true,
        })
        .click()
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("columnheader", { name: new RegExp(label, "i") }),
      ).toHaveAttribute("aria-sort", "descending")
      await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("sortDir=desc")
    }
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Page 2", exact: true }).click()
    await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("page=2")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", {
        name: "Sort by date requested, descending",
        exact: true,
      })
      .click()
    await expect.poll(() => state.queries.at(-1)).toContain("page=1")
    await page.screenshot({
      path: `test-results/issue142-inbox-${width}.png`,
      fullPage: true,
    })
    expect(
      await page.evaluate(
        () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth,
      ),
    ).toBe(true)
  })

    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 920 })
    const state = await mockInbox(page)
    await page.goto("/request-inbox")
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Request Inbox", exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText("Showing 1–10 of 11")).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("table", { name: "Department requests" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText("SR-INBOX-1", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    if (width === 390)
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Open navigation menu" }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("link", { name: "Request Inbox", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("aria-current", "page")
    if (width === 390)
      await page
        .getByRole("complementary", { name: "Primary navigation" })
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Close navigation menu" })
        .click()
    await page.screenshot({
      path: `test-results/request-inbox-${width}.png`,
      fullPage: true,
    })
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Page 2", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Showing 11–11 of 11")).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText("booking-11", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("searchbox", { name: "Search requests" })
      .fill("sr-inbox-2")
    await expect(page.getByText("Showing 1–1 of 1")).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText("SR-INBOX-2", { exact: true })).toHaveCount(1)
    await expect(page.getByText("SR-INBOX-2", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("searchbox", { name: "Search requests" })
      .fill("Mara Client 1")
    await expect(page.getByText("Showing 1–3 of 3")).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Review request booking-1", exact: true })
      .click()

    await expect(
      drawer.getByText("client1@example.com", { exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      drawer.getByText("Five accessible pages and a contact form."),

    await expect(drawer.getByText("Reach more customers.")).toBeVisible()

      path: `test-results/request-inbox-details-${width}.png`,

      drawer.getByRole("button", { name: "Accepting…" }),

      drawer.getByRole("link", { name: "Open request workspace", exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(drawer.getByLabel("Message", { exact: true })).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(drawer.getByText("SR-INBOX-1", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await drawer.getByRole("button", { name: "Close booking details" }).click()
    await expect(drawer).not.toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("button", {
        name: "Review request booking-1",
        exact: true,

    await page.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Filter requests" }).click()
    await page
      .getByRole("option", { name: "Under review", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Showing 1–1 of 1")).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Review request booking-1", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(drawer).toBeVisible()
    await drawer
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Go to chat", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/messages\?request=booking-1$/)
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("region", { name: "Request conversation" }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByRole("dialog")).toHaveCount(0)
    await page.goto("/request-inbox")
    await page
      .getByRole("searchbox", { name: "Search requests" })
      .fill("nothing matches")
    await expect(page.getByText("No requests match this view.")).toBeVisible()
    expect(
      await page.evaluate(
        () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth,
      ),
    ).toBe(true)
  })

tests.title: head can retry failures and a concurrent acceptance refreshes stale details
tests.testSource:
test("head can retry failures and a concurrent acceptance refreshes stale details", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const state = await mockInbox(page)
  state.listError = true
  await page.goto("/request-inbox")
  await expect(page.getByText("Inbox temporarily unavailable.")).toBeVisible()
  state.listError = false
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" }).click()
  state.detailsError = true
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Review request booking-1", exact: true })
    .click()
  await expect(page.getByText("Details temporarily unavailable.")).toBeVisible()
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("button", { name: "Accept request", exact: true }),
  ).toHaveCount(0)
  state.detailsError = false
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" }).click()
  state.acceptError = 503
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Accept request", exact: true })
    .click()
  const drawer = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Booking details" })
  await expect(drawer.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
    "Could not save acceptance. Try again.",
  )
  await expect(
    drawer.getByRole("button", { name: "Accept request", exact: true }),
  ).toBeEnabled()
  state.acceptError = 409
  await drawer
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Accept request", exact: true })
    .click()
  await expect(
    drawer.getByText(
      "Another department accepted this request. Its conversation is private to that department and the client.",
      {
        exact: true,
      },
    ),
  ).toBeVisible()
  await expect(
    drawer.getByRole("button", { name: "Accept request", exact: true }),
  ).toHaveCount(0)
  expect(state.accepts).toBe(2)
})

test("request detail information rejects blank and whitespace-only instructions", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const workflow = fixture()
  workflow.state = "CONSULTATION"
  workflow.permissions.manage = true
  workflow.permissions.isClient = false
  workflow.quotations = []
  workflow.events = []
  const actions = await mock(page, workflow, true)
  await page.goto("/messages?request=request-1")
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Open request actions", exact: true })
    .click()
  await page
    .getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Request information", exact: true })
    .click()
  await chooseToolBooking(page)
  const draft = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Request information" })
  await draft.getByLabel("Requirement title").fill("Project brief")
  await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Send request", exact: true }).click()
  expect(actions).toHaveLength(0)
  await draft.getByLabel("Request detail information (required)").fill("   ")
  await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Send request", exact: true }).click()
  expect(actions).toHaveLength(0)
  await draft
    .getByLabel("Request detail information (required)")
    .fill("Please attach the project brief.")
  await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Send request", exact: true }).click()
  await expect.poll(() => actions.length).toBe(1)
  expect(actions[0]).toMatchObject({
    type: "REQUEST_REQUIREMENT",
    details: "Please attach the project brief.",
  })
})

test(`quotation form formats amounts and uses custom date and time controls at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
    await page.clock.install({ time: new Date("2026-11-06T08:00:00Z") })
    const workflow = fixture()
    workflow.state = "QUOTATION_PENDING"
    workflow.quotations = []
    workflow.events = []
    workflow.paymentRequired = true
    workflow.permissions.manage = true
    workflow.permissions.isClient = false
    const actions = await mock(page, workflow, true)
    await page.goto("/messages?request=request-1")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Open request actions", exact: true })
      .click()
    await page
      .getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Create quotation", exact: true })
      .click()
    await chooseToolBooking(page)
    const chat = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Request conversation" })
    const draft = chat.getByRole("region", { name: "Prepare quotation" })
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Create quotation", exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    const message = chat.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Message", exact: true })
    await message.fill("Quotation details stay connected to this chat.")
    await expect(message).toHaveValue(
      "Quotation details stay connected to this chat.",
    )
    const sheetBox = await draft.boundingBox()
    const composerBox = await chat
      .getByRole("form", { name: "Send a message" })
      .boundingBox()
    expect(
      Math.abs(composerBox!.y - (sheetBox!.y + sheetBox!.height) - 8),
    ).toBeLessThan(2)
    expect(sheetBox!.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(400)
    const details = page.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Request context" })
    await expect(details).toBeVisible()
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    const deliverables = draft.getByLabel("Deliverables (one per line)")
    await expect(deliverables).toBeFocused()
    await expect(deliverables).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true")
    await expect(deliverables).toHaveAccessibleDescription(
      "Complete this field.",
    )
    await expect(draft.locator("[data-field-error]")).toHaveText(
      "Complete this field.",
    )
    await expect(draft.locator("form")).toHaveAttribute("novalidate", "")
    expect(actions).toHaveLength(0)
    await draft
      .getByLabel("Deliverables (one per line)")
      .fill("Accessible website\nProduction deployment")
    await expect(deliverables).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true")
    await expect(draft.locator("[data-field-error]")).toHaveCount(0)
    await chat
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Hide service details", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(draft).toBeVisible()
    await chat
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Show service details", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(details).toBeVisible()
    await expect(draft.getByLabel("Deliverables (one per line)")).toHaveValue(
      "Accessible website\nProduction deployment",
    )
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await draft.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Currency", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      page.getByRole("option", { name: "USD · US Dollar", exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await page
      .getByRole("option", { name: "USD · US Dollar", exact: true })
      .click()
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    const item = draft.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Item 1", exact: true })
    await expect(item).toBeFocused()
    await expect(item).toHaveAccessibleDescription("Complete this field.")
    await expect(item).toBeInViewport()
    await expect(draft.locator("[data-field-error]")).toBeInViewport()
    await expect
      .poll(() =>
        draft.locator("[data-field-error]").evaluate((element) => {
          const box = element.getBoundingClientRect()
          return (
            document.elementFromPoint(
              box.x + box.width / 2,
              box.y + box.height / 2,
            ) === element
          )
        }),
      )
      .toBe(true)
    await page.screenshot({
      path: `test-results/quotation-validation-${width}.png`,
    })
    await item.fill("Website delivery")
    const quantity = draft.getByRole("spinbutton", {
      name: "Quantity",
      exact: true,
    })
    await quantity.fill("0")
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(quantity).toBeFocused()
    await expect(quantity).toHaveAccessibleDescription(
      "Enter a value of 1 or more.",
    )
    await quantity.fill("1")
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    const price = draft.getByLabel("Unit price", { exact: true })
    await expect(price).toBeFocused()
    await expect(price).toHaveAccessibleDescription("Complete this field.")
    await price.pressSequentially("1234567.89", { delay: 20 })
    await expect(price).toHaveValue("1,234,567.89")
    await expect(draft.locator("[data-field-error]")).toHaveCount(0)
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await draft
      .getByLabel("Payment terms", { exact: true })
      .fill("Deposit before commencement, balance on delivery.")
    const amount = draft.getByLabel("Amount due before commencement", {
      exact: true,
    })
    await amount.fill("1234.5")
    await expect(amount).toHaveValue("1,234.5")
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Review", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(draft.getByRole("alert")).toContainText(
      "Choose a future validity date",
    )
    await expect(amount).toHaveValue("1,234.50")
    const validity = draft.getByRole("button", {
      name: "Valid until",
      exact: true,
    })
    const amountBox = await amount.boundingBox()
    const dateBox = await validity.boundingBox()
    expect(
      Math.abs(amountBox!.y + amountBox!.height - dateBox!.y - dateBox!.height),
    ).toBeLessThan(1)
    expect(Math.abs(amountBox!.height - dateBox!.height)).toBeLessThan(1)
    expect(Math.abs(amountBox!.width - dateBox!.width)).toBeLessThan(1)
    await expect(validity).toHaveText("Select date & time")
    expect(dateBox!.x).toBeGreaterThan(amountBox!.x + amountBox!.width)
    await validity.click()
    const picker = page.getByRole("dialog", {
      name: "Select date and time",
      exact: true,
    })
    await expect(
      picker.getByRole("button", { name: "Previous month", exact: true }),
    ).toBeDisabled()
    await expect(
      picker.getByRole("button", {
        name: "Sunday, November 1, 2026",
        exact: true,
      }),
    ).toBeDisabled()
    await picker
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Friday, November 20, 2026", exact: true })
      .click()
    await picker.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Hour", exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "09", exact: true }).click()
    await picker.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Minute", exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "30", exact: true }).click()
    await picker.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Period", exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "AM", exact: true }).click()
    await picker.screenshot({
      path: `test-results/quotation-date-time-${width}.png`,
    })
    await picker
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Apply date & time", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect(picker).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(validity).toBeFocused()
    await expect(validity).toHaveAttribute("title", /November 20, 2026/)
    await expect(draft.locator('input[name="validUntil"]')).toHaveValue(
      "2026-11-20T09:30",
    )
    await page.screenshot({
      path: `test-results/quotation-terms-${width}.png`,
    })
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Review", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      draft.getByRole("region", { name: "Quotation review" }),
    ).toContainText("1,234,567.89")
    await draft
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Send quotation", exact: true })
      .click()
    await expect.poll(() => actions.length).toBe(1)
    expect(actions[0]).toMatchObject({
      type: "CREATE_QUOTATION",
      currency: "USD",
      lineItems: [
        {
          description: "Website delivery",
          quantity: 1,
          unitPrice: "1234567.89",
        },
      ],
      paymentDue: "1234.50",
    })
    expect(
      await page.evaluate(
        () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth,
      ),
    ).toBe(true)
  })

test(`quotation revisions preserve all items and edits across steps at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
    const workflow = fixture()
    workflow.state = "REVISION_REQUESTED"
    workflow.paymentRequired = true
    workflow.permissions.manage = true
    workflow.permissions.isClient = false
    workflow.quotations[0]!.status = "REVISION_REQUESTED"
    workflow.quotations[0]!.validUntil = new Date(
      Date.now() + 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
    ).toISOString()
    workflow.quotations[0]!.lineItems.push({
      description: "Hosting",
      quantity: 2,
      unitPrice: "500.00",
    })
    const actions = await mock(page, workflow, true)
    await page.goto("/messages?request=request-1")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Prepare revised quotation" })
      .click()
    const draft = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Prepare quotation" })
    await draft
      .getByLabel("Deliverables (one per line)")
      .fill(
        Array.from({ length: 31 }, (_, index) => `Deliverable ${index}`).join(
          "\n",
        ),
      )
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(draft.getByLabel("Service scope")).toBeVisible()
    await draft
      .getByLabel("Deliverables (one per line)")
      .fill("Five accessible pages\nProduction deployment")
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(draft.getByLabel("Item 1", { exact: true })).toHaveValue(
      "Website delivery",
    )
    await expect(draft.getByLabel("Item 2", { exact: true })).toHaveValue(
      "Hosting",
    )
    await draft.getByLabel("Item 2", { exact: true }).fill("Managed hosting")
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Back", exact: true }).click()
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(draft.getByLabel("Item 2", { exact: true })).toHaveValue(
      "Managed hosting",
    )
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    const validity = draft.locator('input[name="validUntil"]')
    const validUntil = await validity.inputValue()
    await draft
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Valid until", exact: true })
      .click()
    const picker = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Select date and time" })
    await picker.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Hour", exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "09", exact: true }).click()
    await picker.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(validity).toHaveValue(validUntil)
    await draft.getByLabel("Amount due before commencement").fill("99999")
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Review", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      draft.getByLabel("Amount due before commencement"),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await draft.getByLabel("Amount due before commencement").fill("0")
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Review", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      draft.getByLabel("Amount due before commencement"),
    ).toBeVisible()
    await draft.getByLabel("Amount due before commencement").fill("12500.00")
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Review", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      draft.getByRole("region", { name: "Quotation review" }),
    ).toContainText("Managed hosting")
    await page.screenshot({
      path: `test-results/issue141-quotation-review-${width}.png`,
      fullPage: true,
    })
    expect(actions).toHaveLength(0)
    await draft.getByRole("button", { name: "Send revised quotation" }).click()
    await expect.poll(() => actions.length).toBe(1)
    expect(actions[0]!.lineItems).toEqual([
      { description: "Website delivery", quantity: 1, unitPrice: "25000.00" },
      { description: "Managed hosting", quantity: 2, unitPrice: "500.00" },
    ])
    expect(
      await page.evaluate(
        () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth,
      ),
    ).toBe(true)
  })

test("department heads can confirm payment or reject it with a required reason", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const workflow = fixture()
  workflow.state = "AGREEMENT_PAYMENT_PENDING"
  workflow.permissions = {
    manage: true,
    isClient: false,
    approveQuotation: false,
    verifyPayment: false,
  }
  workflow.agreement = {
    id: "agreement-1",
    mandatory: true,
    status: "APPROVED",
    documentFileId: null,
    signedFileId: null,
  }
  workflow.payment = {
    id: "payment-1",
    mandatory: true,
    amount: "12500.00",
    currency: "PHP",
    status: "SUBMITTED",
    proofFileId: null,
    reference: "BANK-123",
  }
  workflow.internal = {
    staff: [],
    approvers: [{ id: "admin-1", fullName: "Finance Reviewer" }],
    quotationApproverId: "quotation-admin",
    paymentVerifierId: null,
    events: [],
  }
  workflow.events = [
    {
      id: "payment-submitted",
      type: "PAYMENT_SUBMITTED",
      summary: "Payment proof submitted",
      entityId: "payment-1",
      createdAt: "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
      actor: null,
    },
  ]
  const actions = await mock(page, workflow, true)
  await page.goto("/messages?request=request-1")
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Reject payment", exact: true })
    .click()
  expect(actions).toHaveLength(0)
  await expect(page.locator("[data-field-error]")).toHaveText(
    "Enter a reason for rejecting this payment.",
  )
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Verification note", exact: true }),
  ).toBeFocused()
  await page
    .getByRole("textbox", { name: "Verification note", exact: true })
    .fill("Receipt does not match the amount")
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Reject payment", exact: true })
    .click()
  await expect.poll(() => actions.length).toBe(1)
  expect(actions[0]).toMatchObject({
    type: "VERIFY_PAYMENT",
    approve: false,
    note: "Receipt does not match the amount",
  })
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm payment", exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible()
  await page.getByLabel("Verification note", { exact: true }).fill("")
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm payment", exact: true })
    .click()
  await expect.poll(() => actions.length).toBe(2)
  expect(actions[1]).toMatchObject({
    type: "VERIFY_PAYMENT",
    approve: true,
    note: "",
  })
})

test(
    "head verifies payment, assigns staff and activates a workspace at " +
      width +
      "px",
    async ({ page }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: width === 390 ? 844 : 1000 })
      const workflow = fixture()
      workflow.state = "AGREEMENT_PAYMENT_PENDING"
      workflow.permissions.manage = true
      workflow.permissions.isClient = false
      workflow.approval = {
        quotationId: "quote-1",

        currency: "PHP",
        approvedById: "client-1",
        approvedAt: "2026-10-30T08:00:00.000Z",
      }
      workflow.payment = {
        id: "payment-1",
        mandatory: true,
        amount: "12500.00",
        currency: "PHP",
        status: "SUBMITTED",
        proofFileId: null,
        reference: "BANK-123",
      }
      workflow.agreement = {
        id: "agreement-1",
        mandatory: true,
        status: "APPROVED",
        documentFileId: null,
        signedFileId: null,
      }
      workflow.project = {
        id: "project-1",
        name: "Business website",
        status: "PLANNED",
      }
      workflow.events = [
        {
          id: "payment-submitted",
          type: "PAYMENT_SUBMITTED",

          createdAt: "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",

        },

      workflow.internal = {
        staff: [
          {
            id: "employee-1",
            fullName: "Dani Worker",
            position: "Designer",
            status: "ACTIVE",
            skills: [],
            activeProjectCount: 0,
            assigned: false,
          },
          {
            id: "employee-2",
            fullName: "Alex Designer",
            position: "Designer",
            status: "ACTIVE",
            skills: ["Figma"],
            activeProjectCount: 2,
            assigned: false,
          },
          {
            id: "employee-3",
            fullName: "Sam Worker",
            position: "Designer",
            status: "ON_LEAVE",
            skills: [],
            activeProjectCount: 1,
            assigned: false,
          },
        ],
        approvers: [],
        quotationApproverId: null,
        paymentVerifierId: null,
        events: [],
      }
      await mock(page, workflow, true)
      const actions: Record<string, unknown>[] = []
      const staffingAttempts: Record<string, unknown>[] = []
      await page.route(
        "**/api/request-workflows/request-1/actions",
        async (route) => {
          const action = route.request().postDataJSON() as Record<
            string,
            unknown
          >
          if (action.type === "STAFF_PROJECT") {
            staffingAttempts.push(action)
            if (staffingAttempts.length === 1) {
              await route.fulfill({
                status: 503,
                json: {
                  error: "Staffing temporarily unavailable. Please retry.",
                },
              })
              return
            }
            for (const person of workflow.internal!.staff)
              person.assigned = (action.employeeIds as string[]).includes(
                person.id,
              )
          }
          actions.push(action)
          if (action.type === "VERIFY_PAYMENT") {
            workflow.payment!.status = "VERIFIED"
            workflow.state = "READY_FOR_ACTIVATION"
          }
          if (action.type === "ACTIVATE_PROJECT") {
            workflow.state = "ACTIVE_PROJECT"
            workflow.project!.status = "IN_PROGRESS"

              id: "project-activated",

        page.getByRole("button", { name: "Activate project", exact: true }),

        .click()

        .getByRole("button", { name: "Hide service details", exact: true })
        .click()
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Open request actions", exact: true })
        .click()

        name: "Project activation",
        exact: true,
      })
      await expect(page.getByRole("menuitem").last()).toContainText(
        "Project activation",
      )
      await expect(nextTool).toHaveText("Project activation")
      await nextTool.click()
      await chooseToolBooking(page)
      const setup = page.getByRole("dialog", {
        name: "Activate project",
        exact: true,
      })
      await expect(setup).toBeVisible()
      const activate = setup.getByRole("button", {
        name: "Activate project",
        exact: true,
      })
      await expect(activate).toHaveCount(0)
      await expect(
        setup.getByRole("button", { name: "Approve staffing", exact: true }),
      ).toBeDisabled()
      await expect(
        setup.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /Sam Worker/ }),
      ).toBeDisabled()
      await setup.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /Dani Worker/ }).check()
      await setup.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel", exact: true }).click()
      await expect(setup).toHaveCount(0)
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("button", { name: "Open request actions", exact: true }),
      ).toBeFocused()
      expect(actions).toHaveLength(1)
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Open request actions", exact: true })
        .click()
      await nextTool.click()
      await chooseToolBooking(page)
      await expect(
        setup.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /Dani Worker/ }),
      ).not.toBeChecked()
      await setup.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /Dani Worker/ }).check()

        fullPage: true,
      })
      await setup
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Approve staffing", exact: true })

      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: width === 390 ? 844 : 1000 })

      workflow.permissions.isClient = false
      workflow.approval = {
        quotationId: "quote-1",
        amount: "25000.00",
        currency: "PHP",
        approvedById: "client-1",
        approvedAt: "2026-10-30T08:00:00.000Z",
      }
      workflow.payment = {
        id: "payment-1",
        mandatory: true,
        amount: "12500.00",
        currency: "PHP",
        status: "SUBMITTED",
        proofFileId: null,
        reference: "BANK-123",
      }
      workflow.agreement = {
        id: "agreement-1",
        mandatory: true,
        status: "APPROVED",
        documentFileId: null,
        signedFileId: null,
      }
      workflow.project = {
        id: "project-1",

        paymentVerifierId: null,

      await page.route(
        "**/api/request-workflows/request-1/actions",
        async (route) => {
          const action = route.request().postDataJSON() as Record<
            string,
            unknown
          >
          if (action.type === "STAFF_PROJECT") {
            staffingAttempts.push(action)
            if (staffingAttempts.length === 1) {
              await route.fulfill({
                status: 503,
                json: {
                  error: "Staffing temporarily unavailable. Please retry.",
                },
              })
              return
            }
            for (const person of workflow.internal!.staff)
              person.assigned = (action.employeeIds as string[]).includes(
                person.id,
              )

test("preserves client sorting, filtering, actions, states, and accessibility", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 })
    const state = await mockClientTable(page, true)
    await page.goto("/clients")

    const table = page.getByRole("table", { name: "Clients" })
    await expect(table).toHaveAttribute("aria-busy", "true")
    await expect(table.getByRole("status")).toHaveText("Loading clients…")

    state.releaseFirstRequest()
    await expect(table).toHaveAttribute("aria-busy", "false")
    await expect(table.getByText("Zeta Client", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      table.getByRole("columnheader", { name: /Date registered/i }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("aria-sort", "descending")

    await table.getByRole("button", { name: /^Sort by Client name$/i }).click()
    await expect(
      table.getByRole("columnheader", { name: /Client name/i }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("aria-sort", "ascending")
    await expect(table.getByRole("row").nth(1)).toContainText("Alpha Client")

tests.testSource:
test("service wizard persists consultation and single recurring pricing after reload", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN")
    await page.goto("/services")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog")
    const selectStep = (name: string) =>
      dialog
        .getByRole("navigation", { name: "Service form progress" })
        .getByRole("button", { name })
        .click()
    await selectStep("Benefits")
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Add Benefit" }).click()
    await dialog.getByLabel("Benefit Title").fill("Launch with confidence")
    await dialog
      .getByLabel("Benefit Description")
      .fill("A guided process from discovery through delivery.")
    await page.mouse.click(2, 2)
    await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Benefit Title")).toHaveValue(
      "Launch with confidence",
    )
    await selectStep("Requirements")
    await dialog
      .getByRole("textbox", { name: /Client Requirements/ })
      .fill("  Brand guide  \n\nProject brief")
    await dialog
      .getByLabel("Consultation is required before proceeding")
      .check()
    await dialog.getByLabel("Consultation Notes").fill("Discuss project scope")
    await selectStep("Pricing")
    await dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }).click()
    await page
      .getByRole("option", { name: "Create a reusable template" })
      .click()
    await dialog
      .getByLabel("Template Name", { exact: true })
      .fill("Monthly support")
    await dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Model", { exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Recurring", exact: true }).click()
    await dialog.getByLabel("Amount (PHP)").fill("1500.50")
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    await expect(dialog.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
      "Select a billing interval",
    )
    await dialog.getByLabel("Billing Interval").click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Monthly", exact: true }).click()
    const saved = page.waitForRequest(
      (request) =>
        request.method() === "PUT" &&
        new URL(request.url()).pathname === "/api/services/service-1",
    )
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    expect((await saved).postDataJSON()).toMatchObject({
      clientRequirements: ["Brand guide", "Project brief"],
      requiresConsultation: true,
      consultationNotes: "Discuss project scope",
      keyBenefits: [
        {
          title: "Launch with confidence",
          description: "A guided process from discovery through delivery.",
        },
      ],
      pricingTemplateId: null,
      pricingTemplate: {
        name: "Monthly support",
        pricingModel: "RECURRING",
        amount: 1500.5,
        currency: "PHP",
        billingInterval: "MONTHLY",
        isPublic: true,
      },
      packages: [],
    })
    await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
    await page.reload()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "View Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    for (const text of [
      "Brand guide; Project brief",
      "Discuss project scope",
    ]) {
      await expect(dialog).toContainText(text)
    }
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Close details" }).click()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    await selectStep("Benefits")
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Benefit Title")).toHaveValue(
      "Launch with confidence",
    )
    await selectStep("Requirements")
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Consultation Notes")).toHaveValue(
      "Discuss project scope",
    )
    await dialog
      .getByLabel("Consultation is required before proceeding")
      .uncheck()
    await selectStep("Pricing")
    await expect(
      dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }),
    ).toContainText("Monthly support")
    await selectStep("Options")
    await expect(dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Pricing/ })).toBeChecked()
    await expect(
      dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Packages/ }),
    ).not.toBeChecked()
    await expect(
      dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(
      dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible()
    const updated = page.waitForRequest(
      (request) =>
        request.method() === "PUT" &&
        new URL(request.url()).pathname === "/api/services/service-1",
    )
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    expect((await updated).postDataJSON()).toMatchObject({
      requiresConsultation: false,
      consultationNotes: null,
      pricingTemplateId: "pricing-1",
      pricingTemplate: null,
      packages: [],
    })
    await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
  })

tests.testSource:
test("service packages are exclusive with pricing and can be replaced during editing", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await restoreSession(page, "ADMIN")
    await page.goto("/services")
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog")
    const selectStep = (name: string) =>
      dialog
        .getByRole("navigation", { name: "Service form progress" })
        .getByRole("button", { name })
        .click()
    await selectStep("Pricing")
    await dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }).click()
    await page
      .getByRole("option", { name: "Create a reusable template" })
      .click()
    // An unfinished draft in the other mode must not block saving packages.
    await selectStep("Options")
    await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Packages/ }).check()
    await expect(
      dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Package Name")).toHaveCount(2)
    await expect(
      dialog.getByLabel("Pricing Template", { exact: true }),
    ).toHaveCount(0)
    for (const [index, name] of ["Starter", "Premium"].entries()) {
      await dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").nth(index).fill(name)
      await dialog
        .getByLabel("Description", { exact: true })
        .nth(index)
        .fill(`${name} support package`)
      await dialog
        .getByLabel("Included Features")
        .nth(index)
        .fill(" Email support \n\nMonthly review")
    }
    await dialog.getByLabel("Recommended", { exact: true }).first().check()
    await dialog
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Remove", exact: true })
      .last()
      .click()
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    await expect(dialog.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
      "Add at least two packages, or choose Pricing for a single option",
    )
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Add Package" }).click()
    await dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").last().fill("Premium")
    await dialog
      .getByLabel("Description", { exact: true })
      .last()
      .fill("Premium support package")
    await dialog.getByLabel("Included Features").last().fill("Priority support")
    const saved = page.waitForRequest(
      (request) =>
        request.method() === "PUT" &&
        new URL(request.url()).pathname === "/api/services/service-1",
    )
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    expect((await saved).postDataJSON()).toMatchObject({
      pricingTemplateId: null,
      pricingTemplate: null,
      packages: [
        expect.objectContaining({
          name: "Starter",
          includedFeatures: ["Email support", "Monthly review"],
          isRecommended: true,
        }),
        expect.objectContaining({ name: "Premium" }),
      ],
    })
    await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
    await page.reload()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    await selectStep("Options")
    await expect(dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Packages/ })).toBeChecked()
    await selectStep("Packages")
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").first()).toHaveValue(
      "Starter",
    )
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").last()).toHaveValue(
      "Premium",
    )
    // Invalid package drafts must not block switching back to single pricing.
    await dialog.getByLabel("Package Name").first().fill("")
    await selectStep("Options")
    await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Pricing/ }).check()
    await selectStep("Pricing")
    await expect(dialog.getByLabel("Package Name")).toHaveCount(0)
    const updated = page.waitForRequest(
      (request) =>
        request.method() === "PUT" &&
        new URL(request.url()).pathname === "/api/services/service-1",
    )
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Save Changes" }).click()
    expect((await updated).postDataJSON()).toMatchObject({ packages: [] })
    await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0)
    await page.reload()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Test Service", exact: true })
      .click()
    await selectStep("Options")
    await expect(dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Pricing/ })).toBeChecked()
  })

tests.title: superadmin can restore a soft-deleted account at 390px
tests.testSource:
test(`superadmin can restore a soft-deleted account at ${width}px`, async ({
      page,
    }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
      await restoreSession(page, "SUPERADMIN", {
        initialUsers: [
          {
            ...accountFor("USER"),
            id: "trashed-target",
            email: "target@example.com",
            fullName: "Target User",
            isActive: false,
            accountDeletedAt: "2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z",
          },
        ],
      })
      let attempts = 0
      let releaseRestore: (() => void) | undefined
      await page.route("**/api/users/trashed-target/restore", async (route) => {
        attempts += 1
        expect(route.request().method()).toBe("POST")
        expect(route.request().headers().authorization).toBe(
          "Bearer test-session",
        )
        if (attempts === 1) {
          await route.fulfill({
            status: 503,
            json: { error: "Restore failed. Please retry." },
          })
          return
        }
        await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
          releaseRestore = resolve
        })
        await route.fallback()
      })
      await page.goto("/accounts")
      await expect(page.getByText("Target User")).toBeHidden()
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Trash", exact: true }).click()
      await expect(page.getByText("Target User")).toBeVisible()
      const openRestore = async () => {
        await page
          .getByRole("button", { name: "More actions for target@example.com" })
          .click()
        await page
          .getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Restore account", exact: true })
          .click()
      }
      await openRestore()
      const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog")
      await expect(
        dialog.getByRole("heading", { name: "Restore account?" }),
      ).toBeVisible()
      await expect(dialog).toContainText("as inactive")
      await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel", exact: true }).click()
      expect(attempts).toBe(0)
      await openRestore()
      await dialog
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Restore account", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(dialog.getByRole("alert")).toHaveText(
        "Restore failed. Please retry.",
      )
      await dialog
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Restore account", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(
        dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Restoring...", exact: true }),
      ).toBeDisabled()
      await expect(
        dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel", exact: true }),
      ).toBeDisabled()
      await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
      await expect(dialog).toBeVisible()
      await expect.poll(() => Boolean(releaseRestore)).toBe(true)
      releaseRestore?.()
      await expect(dialog).toBeHidden()
      await expect(page.getByText("Target User")).toBeHidden()
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Back to Accounts", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(page.getByText("Target User")).toBeVisible()
      await expect(page.getByText("Inactive", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "More actions for target@example.com" })
        .click()
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Restore account", exact: true }),
      ).toBeHidden()
      await page
        .getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Reactivate account", exact: true })
        .click()
      await page
        .getByRole("dialog")
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Reactivate account", exact: true })
        .click()
      await expect(page.getByText("Active", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
      expect(attempts).toBe(2)
    })

test("superadmin can move an inactive account to Trash and delete it permanently", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await restoreSession(page, "SUPERADMIN")
    await page.goto("/accounts")

    const searchInput = page.getByPlaceholder("Search name or email")
    await searchInput.fill("Target")

    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "More actions for target@example.com" })
      .click()
    await page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Deactivate account" }).click()
    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "Deactivate account", exact: true })
      .click()

    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "More actions for target@example.com" })
      .click()
    await page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Move to trash" }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Move account to Trash?")).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Move to Trash" }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Target User")).toBeHidden()

    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Trash", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Target User")).toBeVisible()
    await expect(
      page
        .getByText("Deleted", { exact: true })
        .filter({ visible: true })
        .first(),
    ).toBeVisible()

    await page
      .getByRole("button", { name: "More actions for target@example.com" })
      .click()
    await page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Delete permanently" }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Permanently delete account?")).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete permanently" }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Target User")).toBeHidden()
  })

test(`workspace, team, task and deliverable tables use shared row transitions at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }, testInfo) => {
    test.skip(live, "Uses isolated workspaces")
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "no-preference" })
    await restoreSession(page, "STAFF")
    const alpha = workspaceFixture("Alpha Project", "alpha")
    const beta = workspaceFixture("Beta Project", "beta")
    await page.route("**/api/project-workspace?**", (route) =>
      route.fulfill({ json: { workspaces: [alpha, beta], canCreate: false } }),
    )
    await page.route("**/api/project-workspace/alpha", (route) =>
      route.fulfill({ json: alpha }),
    )
    await page.goto("/dashboard")
    if (width < 768)
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Open navigation menu" }).click()
    const submenuToggle = page.getByRole("button", {
      name: "Toggle project workspace submenu",
    })

import type { Permission } from "./permissions"
import type { DepartmentColor } from "@/features/departments/model/department-color"

export type AuthMode = "login" | "register"

export type AuthLanguage = "en" | "fil"

export type Account = {
  id: string
  email: string
  fullName: string | null
  imageUrl?: string | null
  contactNumber: string | null
  role: "SUPERADMIN" | "ADMIN" | "STAFF" | "USER"
  isActive: boolean
  accountDeletedAt?: string | null
  position?: string | null
  departmentId?: string | null
  department?: {
    id: string
    name: string
    code: string | null
    color: DepartmentColor
  } | null
  teamId?: string | null
  headOf?: { id: string; name: string } | null
  team?: { id: string; name: string } | null
  permissions: Permission[]
  createdAt: string
}

export type RegistrationData = {
  fullName: string
  contactNumber: string
  email: string
  password: string
}

import { apiRequest } from "@/features/auth/api/auth-api"
export type Preferences = {
  timeZone: string
  dateFormat: "MM/DD/YYYY" | "DD/MM/YYYY" | "YYYY-MM-DD"
  timeFormat: "12h" | "24h"
  workflowNotifications: boolean
}
export type Session = {
  id: string
  device: string
  location?: string | null
  createdAt: string
  lastActiveAt: string | null
  current: boolean
}
export type Settings = { preferences: Preferences; sessions: Session[] }
export const defaultPreferences: Preferences = {
  timeZone: "Asia/Manila",
  dateFormat: "MM/DD/YYYY",
  timeFormat: "12h",
  workflowNotifications: true,
}
export const getSettings = (signal?: AbortSignal) =>
  apiRequest<Settings>("/api/auth/settings", { signal })
export const savePreferences = (preferences: Preferences) =>
  apiRequest<Preferences>("/api/auth/settings", {
    method: "PATCH",
    body: JSON.stringify(preferences),
  })
export const revokeSession = (id: string) =>
  apiRequest<void>("/api/auth/sessions/" + encodeURIComponent(id), {
    method: "DELETE",
  })
export const revokeOtherSessions = () =>
  apiRequest<void>("/api/auth/sessions/revoke-others", { method: "POST" })

export const revokeAllSessions = () =>
  apiRequest<void>("/api/auth/sessions/revoke-all", { method: "POST" })
